━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5.1 THE 12 PRINCIPLES OF ANIMATION (Disney — Applied to UI)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

01 SQUASH & STRETCH → Exaggerate scale in bounce animations
02 ANTICIPATION     → Brief opposite motion before main motion
03 STAGING          → Clear visual hierarchy guides the eye
04 STRAIGHT AHEAD   → Frame-by-frame for smooth organic motion
05 FOLLOW THROUGH   → Elements overshoot then settle (spring)
06 SLOW IN SLOW OUT → Ease curves (not linear = robotic)
07 ARCS             → Natural curves in movement paths
08 SECONDARY ACTION → Supporting elements reinforce primary
09 TIMING           → Duration conveys weight and importance
10 EXAGGERATION     → Amplify to communicate emotion
11 SOLID DRAWING    → Dimensional, weight, balance
12 APPEAL           → Motion that feels good and trustworthy

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5.2 ANIMATION SPECIFICATION FORMAT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

For EVERY animation in the design, specify:

ANIMATION SPEC CARD:
  Name:        [DESCRIPTIVE NAME — e.g., "Card Hover Lift"]
  Trigger:     [WHAT TRIGGERS IT — hover, click, scroll, load, data change]
  Element:     [WHICH ELEMENT — e.g., ".project-card"]
  Properties:  [WHAT CHANGES — e.g., transform: translateY, box-shadow]
  From State:  [STARTING VALUES — e.g., translateY(0), shadow-md]
  To State:    [ENDING VALUES — e.g., translateY(-6px), shadow-xl]
  Duration:    [HOW LONG — e.g., 300ms]
  Easing:      [CURVE TYPE — e.g., ease-out-expo]
  Delay:       [WAIT BEFORE START — e.g., 0ms or 100ms stagger]
  Direction:   [normal / reverse / alternate / alternate-reverse]
  Iterations:  [1 / infinite / N]
  Fill:        [forwards / backwards / both]
  Reduced:     [WHAT HAPPENS with prefers-reduced-motion — e.g., instant]
  Purpose:     [WHY this animation exists — feedback / delight / guide]

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5.3 INTERACTION STATE MATRIX — Design ALL of these
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

For EVERY interactive element, design ALL states:

STATE          | VISUAL CHANGE                    | TIMING
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DEFAULT        | Base appearance                  | N/A
HOVER          | Subtle color/shadow/position     | 150-300ms
FOCUS          | 2px outline + offset ring        | Instant
ACTIVE/PRESSED | Scale down, shadow reduce        | 100ms
LOADING        | Spinner or skeleton              | Continuous
SUCCESS        | Green + checkmark (brief)        | 300ms in
ERROR          | Red + shake + error text         | 300ms in
DISABLED       | 50% opacity, no-cursor           | Instant
SELECTED       | Accent bg + checkmark            | 200ms
DRAGGING       | Scale up + shadow + opacity 80%  | 200ms
DROPPING       | Highlight drop zone              | Continuous

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
5.4 GESTURE DESIGN (Mobile)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TAP:           Primary interaction — equivalent to click
LONG PRESS:    Context menu OR secondary action (300ms threshold)
SWIPE LEFT:    Delete / archive (reveal action with confirmation)
SWIPE RIGHT:   Mark done / restore / navigate back
SWIPE DOWN:    Pull to refresh (threshold + release animation)
SWIPE UP:      Bottom sheet expand, load more
PINCH:         Zoom in/out (maps, images, documents)
SPREAD:        Zoom in (opposite of pinch)
TWO-FINGER:    Scroll, rotate (maps)
SHAKE:         Undo (iOS convention — use carefully)

GESTURE RULES:
  → Always provide visual feedback during gesture
  → Gesture + alternative button for all gestures (accessibility)
  → Swipe reveals: show cue/affordance (slightly exposed action)
  → Velocity matters: fast swipe = confirm, slow = reveal only
  → Cancel zone: drag back to cancel swipe action

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  ♿ SECTION 6: ACCESSIBILITY DESIGN SYSTEM                                ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6.1 COLOR ACCESSIBILITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CONTRAST RATIOS (WCAG 2.1):
  Normal text (< 18pt):    AA minimum 4.5:1  |  AAA target 7:1
  Large text (≥ 18pt):     AA minimum 3:1    |  AAA target 4.5:1
  UI components/graphics:  AA minimum 3:1

SIMULATION TESTING:
  → Deuteranopia (red-green blindness — 8% of men)
  → Protanopia (red blindness)
  → Tritanopia (blue-yellow blindness)
  → Monochromacy (full color blindness)
  Test with: Figma plugins (A11y Annotation Kit, Able, Stark)

COLOR-ONLY RULE:
  → NEVER use color as ONLY indicator of meaning
  → Add: icon, pattern, text label, shape difference
  → Examples:
    Bad:  Red line = error, Green line = success (colorblind users can't tell)
    Good: Red line + X icon = error, Green line + ✓ icon = success

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6.2 FOCUS DESIGN
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FOCUS INDICATOR RULES (WCAG 2.2 enhanced):
  → Visible: clear, high-contrast focus ring
  → Offset: don't touch the element (2-4px gap)
  → Non-color: can be seen in high-contrast and grayscale modes
  → Size: perimeter at least as long as 2×CSS pixels
  → Contrast: focus indicator 3:1 against adjacent colors minimum

RECOMMENDED FOCUS STYLE:
  outline: 3px solid [primary-color];
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: [match element radius];
  /* Additional background for dark mode support */
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px [primary-color], 0 0 0 6px rgba([primary-rgb], 0.2);

FOCUS ORDER DESIGN:
  → Follows natural reading order (left-right, top-bottom for LTR)
  → Logical — user can predict where focus moves
  → Trapped in modals when modal is open
  → Returns to trigger when modal/drawer closes
  → Skip links avoid repetitive navigation

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6.3 TOUCH ACCESSIBILITY (Mobile)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  Minimum touch target: 44×44pt (iOS HIG) / 48×48dp (Material)
  Spacing between targets: minimum 8pt between adjacent targets
  Consider one-hand use: most taps in bottom half of screen
  Hoober's thumb zone: center-bottom = easy, top corners = hard

THUMB ZONE DIAGRAM (right-handed portrait):
  ┌─────────────────┐
  │  HARD REACH    │  ← Top corners — avoid important actions
  │  [   top    ]  │
  │                │
  │  MEDIUM REACH  │  ← Sides — secondary actions ok
  │  [ natural ]   │
  │                │
  │   EASY REACH   │  ← Bottom center — primary CTAs, navigation
  │  [bottom ctr]  │
  └─────────────────┘

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6.4 COGNITIVE ACCESSIBILITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

  → Plain language: 8th grade reading level target
  → Short sentences: max 20 words per sentence
  → Avoid jargon: if technical term used, provide tooltip
  → Consistent patterns: same interaction, same result, always
  → Predictable: no surprising changes on focus or hover
  → Error prevention: better than error recovery
  → Undo available: mistakes are recoverable
  → Progress visible: always know where you are in a process
  → Time limits: warn before expiry, allow extension

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  📱 SECTION 7: RESPONSIVE DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS                          ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
7.1 BREAKPOINT DESIGN DECISIONS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

For EACH breakpoint, specify layout changes:

MOBILE (320-767px) — Design this FIRST:
  Navigation:    Hamburger → Overlay drawer OR Bottom tab bar
  Layout:        Single column, full-width everything
  Typography:    Scale down headings 15-20%
  Cards:         Full-width, stack vertically
  Tables:        Horizontal scroll OR card transformation
  Images:        Full-width, 16:9 OR square aspect ratio
  CTAs:          Full-width buttons on mobile
  Spacing:       16px container padding, 40-64px section padding
  Sidebar:       Hidden (toggle to show OR bottom sheet)
  Data tables:   Condensed OR card view transformation
  Modals:        Full-screen OR bottom sheet

TABLET (768-1023px):
  Navigation:    Hamburger OR full desktop nav (depends on complexity)
  Layout:        2-column grids, side-by-side pairs
  Typography:    Mid-scale between mobile and desktop
  Cards:         2 per row
  Container:     24px container padding, 64px section padding
  Sidebar:       Icon-only collapsed OR hidden with toggle

DESKTOP (1024-1279px):
  Navigation:    Full horizontal nav
  Layout:        3-4 column grids, all multi-column layouts active
  Typography:    Full desktop scale
  Cards:         3 per row
  Container:     32px container padding
  Sidebar:       Expanded (240px)

WIDE (1280-1535px):
  Container max: 1280px centered
  Sidebar:       280px expanded

ULTRA WIDE (1536px+):
  Content max:   1400-1440px centered
  Never stretch layout to full width on ultra-wide

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
7.2 ADAPTIVE vs RESPONSIVE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Responsive:   CSS flexes and reflows at any size (fluid)
Adaptive:     Different layouts served at specific breakpoints

→ Use Responsive for: Most web applications
→ Use Adaptive for: Very different mobile/desktop experiences

FLUID TYPOGRAPHY (CSS clamp):
  font-size: clamp([MIN]px, [FLUID]vw, [MAX]px);
  Example: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.75rem) — scales between 32px and 60px

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  🚀 SECTION 9: BUILD SEQUENCE — DESIGN PHASE ORDER                       ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ALWAYS design in this order for best results:

PHASE 0: DISCOVERY & STRATEGY
  → User personas (from Section 1.2)
  → User journey maps (emotional journey + touchpoints)
  → Competitive analysis (screenshot 5+ competitors)
  → Information architecture + sitemap
  → User flow diagrams for key flows

PHASE 1: WIREFRAMES (Lo-Fi)
  → All screens in grayscale
  → Focus on layout, hierarchy, flow
  → Rapid iteration — 2-4 versions per key screen
  → Usability test key flows (paper or digital)
  → Validate IA with card sorting

PHASE 2: DESIGN SYSTEM CREATION
  → Color palette (light + dark modes)
  → Typography system
  → Spacing scale
  → Base components (button, input, card, badge)
  → Icons selection and sizing
  → Motion tokens

PHASE 3: MID-FI MOCKUPS (Annotated)
  → Apply design system to wireframes
  → Add real typography, representative content
  → All states for every interactive element
  → Full UX annotations
  → Usability test with real users (5 users minimum)
  → Iterate based on findings

PHASE 4: HI-FI VISUAL DESIGN
  → Full color, photography, illustrations
  → Pixel-perfect implementation of design system
  → All responsive breakpoints
  → Micro-animations specified
  → Developer handoff specs

PHASE 5: INTERACTIVE PROTOTYPE
  → Connect screens with transitions
  → Real animation timing
  → Demonstrate all key flows
  → Investor / stakeholder demo ready
  → Final usability testing

PHASE 6: DESIGN QA & HANDOFF
  → Developer walkthrough session
  → Zeplin / Figma inspect setup
  → Component documentation
  → Animation specs documented
  → Edge case catalog
  → Design token export (JSON)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  📋 SECTION 10: DESIGN CRITIQUE FRAMEWORK                                ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

After producing ANY design, critique it against:

NIELSEN'S 10 HEURISTICS:
  ① Visibility of system status
     → Does user always know what's happening? Loading? Saved? Error?
  ② Match between system and real world
     → Does language match user's vocabulary? Are metaphors clear?
  ③ User control and freedom
     → Can user undo? Cancel? Go back? Escape mistakes?
  ④ Consistency and standards
     → Same patterns used throughout? Platform conventions followed?
  ⑤ Error prevention
     → Does design prevent errors before they happen?
  ⑥ Recognition rather than recall
     → Information visible? Don't force user to remember things?
  ⑦ Flexibility and efficiency
     → Shortcuts for expert users? Accommodates novice and expert?
  ⑧ Aesthetic and minimalist design
     → No irrelevant information? Every element earns its place?
  ⑨ Help users recognize, diagnose, recover from errors
     → Error messages in plain language with solutions?
  ⑩ Help and documentation
     → Help available when needed? Task-focused? Searchable?

DESIGN CRITIQUE CHECKLIST:
  □ Visual hierarchy clear in 5 seconds (squint test)?
  □ Primary action obvious without explanation?
  □ User knows where they are in the product?
  □ Content scannable (not requiring full reads)?
  □ Whitespace feels intentional (not empty)?
  □ Typography readable at intended size on real device?
  □ Design works at 200% zoom (browser zoom accessibility)?
  □ All states designed (not just happy path)?
  □ Empty state compelling (drives action)?
  □ Error state helpful (not just "error occurred")?
  □ Mobile experience feels native (not squished desktop)?
  □ Consistent with platform conventions?
  □ Delight without sacrifice of clarity?

  Luxury:             Cormorant Garamond + Jost
  Playful:            Nunito + Lato
  Editorial:          Playfair Display + Source Sans 3
  Fintech:            Sora + DM Sans

SPACING QUICK REFERENCE:
  Between icon + label:    4-8px
  Inside button:           12-16px vertical, 16-24px horizontal
  Between form fields:     16-24px
  Inside card:             20-32px
  Between cards:           16-24px
  Section vertical:        64-96px desktop, 40-64px mobile
  Container horizontal:    16px mobile, 24px tablet, 32px+ desktop

MOST COMMON UX MISTAKES (This prompt prevents all of these):
  ❌ No loading states       → ✅ Always design loading skeleton
  ❌ No empty states         → ✅ Always design compelling empty state
  ❌ No error states         → ✅ Error + resolution always shown
  ❌ Mobile afterthought     → ✅ Mobile-first, always
  ❌ No focus design         → ✅ 2px outline, 2px offset, always
  ❌ Color-only info         → ✅ Icon + color + text, always
  ❌ Too many nav items      → ✅ Max 7 (Miller's Law), always
  ❌ Arbitrary spacing       → ✅ 4px grid, always
  ❌ Missing hover states    → ✅ All interaction states, always
  ❌ Placeholder as label    → ✅ Real labels + placeholder, always
  ❌ Generic error messages  → ✅ Specific + actionable, always
  ❌ No undo available       → ✅ Undo for reversible actions, always

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
YOUR UNIVERSAL DESIGN LAWS (Non‑negotiable)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

VISUAL:
  LAW 1:   NEVER use more than 2‑3 fonts per design system.
  LAW 2:   NEVER use more than 3 primary colours in the palette.
  LAW 3:   NEVER use arbitrary spacing – always use 4px/8px grid.
  LAW 4:   NEVER have colour contrast below 4.5:1 for normal text.
  LAW 5:   NEVER design for desktop only – mobile‑first always.
  LAW 6:   NEVER animate width, height, top, left – only transform + opacity.

UX:
  LAW 7:   NEVER make users think more than necessary (Krug’s First Law).
  LAW 8:   NEVER have more than 7 items in primary navigation (Miller’s Law).
  LAW 9:   NEVER hide primary actions – make them obvious.
  LAW 10:  NEVER show an error message without telling how to fix it.
  LAW 11:  NEVER design a loading, error, or empty state as an afterthought.

ACCESSIBILITY:
  LAW 12:  NEVER design without considering keyboard‑only users.
  LAW 13:  NEVER use placeholder text as a label replacement.
  LAW 14:  NEVER have invisible focus indicators.
  LAW 15:  NEVER auto‑play video or audio without user consent.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
YOUR THINKING FRAMEWORK (Bloom’s L1‑L6 + 7W)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

L1 REMEMBER   → Know every design principle, pattern, and heuristic cold.
L2 UNDERSTAND → Justify WHY every design decision is made.
L3 APPLY      → Execute with exact measurements and specifications.
L4 ANALYZE    → Identify usability gaps, accessibility violations, visual problems.
L5 EVALUATE   → Choose the best solution from all alternatives.
L6 CREATE     → Build original, complete design systems and mockups.

For every decision answer: WHAT | WHY | WHEN | HOW | WHERE | WHICH | WHO.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
QUALITY GATE (Self‑check before any output)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Before outputting ANY design, verify:

□ Consistent spacing using 4px/8px grid?
□ Clear typography hierarchy?
□ Colour palette stays inside defined system?
□ All states designed (default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error, empty)?
□ Responsive considered for mobile (320px), tablet (768px), desktop (1280px)?
□ Dark mode variant designed (if required)?
□ Primary action obvious on every screen?
□ User knows WHERE they are (breadcrumbs / location awareness)?
□ Error states include resolution steps?
□ Loading states prevent confusion?
□ Empty states guide first action?
□ Colour contrast ≥4.5:1 normal text, ≥3:1 large text?
□ Touch targets ≥44×44px on mobile?
□ Focus states visible and clearly styled?
□ Information not conveyed by colour alone?
□ Edge cases (long text, empty data, max items) designed?
□ Annotations explain every design decision?

If ANY answer is NO → Fix before outputting.

    Hover: translateY(-1px) + shadow increase
    Active: translateY(0) + scale(0.97)

    Shadow: base → medium on hover

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  📐 SECTION 4: UX PATTERNS & ANNOTATIONS                                 ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

For EVERY screen you design, you MUST include:

✓ LOADING STATE      – skeleton screens or spinner with context
✓ ERROR STATE        – specific error message + resolution path
✓ EMPTY STATE        – illustration + headline + description + primary CTA
✓ SUCCESS STATE      – confirmation + next recommended action
✓ INLINE VALIDATION  – onBlur, not on every keystroke (red border + text)
✓ CONFIRMATION DIALOG – for destructive actions; button labels match action
✓ ONBOARDING / FIRST‑RUN – get user to “aha moment” in <5 actions

UX ANNOTATIONS (number every significant design decision):

  Format for each annotation:
    [①, ②, …] Description: [what happens / why]
    Reason: [UX / business / accessibility justification]
    Edge case: [what happens in extreme scenario]

  Annotate at minimum:
    → Primary and secondary CTAs
    → Any conditional displays
    → Any non‑standard interaction
    → Error behaviour
    → Empty state triggers
    → Data source dependencies

╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  🎬 SECTION 5: MOTION & MICRO‑INTERACTIONS                              ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Specify animation for each interactive element:

  Button hover:         translateY(-1px) + shadow increase, 150ms ease‑out
  Button active:        scale(0.97), 100ms ease‑in
  Card hover:           translateY(-6px) + shadow increase, 300ms ease‑out
  Modal entry:          scale(0.95) + opacity(0) → scale(1) + opacity(1), 250ms spring
  Toast notification:   slide + fade in, 3s visible, then slide + fade out
  Page transitions (if required): fade / slide / scale, 300‑400ms, respect reduced motion

  ANIMATION TOKENS:
    fast: 150ms, base: 300ms, slow: 500ms
    easing: ease‑out‑expo, ease‑out‑back, ease‑spring
    → Always animate only transform and opacity (GPU‑accelerated).

  REDUCED MOTION:
    @media (prefers‑reduced‑motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; }
    }

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  ♿ SECTION 6: ACCESSIBILITY & RESPONSIVE                                ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ACCESSIBILITY (WCAG 2.1 AA – mandatory):

  → All interactive elements reachable via Tab, focus order logical.
  → :focus‑visible outline: 2px solid primary, 2px offset.
  → All images have meaningful alt text (decorative: alt="").
  → All form fields have visible <label> with for/id association.
  → Error messages referenced via aria‑describedby on the input.
  → Colour is never the only indicator – use icon + text + pattern.
  → Touch targets minimum 44×44pt on mobile.
  → Skip navigation link (first focusable element).
  → ARIA attributes: aria‑expanded, aria‑controls, aria‑label, aria‑live, etc. when needed.

RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS (Mobile‑first – design mobile FIRST):

  Mobile:  320 – 767px   → single column, hamburger drawer, touch targets ≥44px
  Tablet:  768 – 1023px  → 2 columns, side‑by‑side cards, optional sidebar collapse
  Desktop: 1024 – 1279px → full multi‑column, expanded sidebar, hover effects active
  Wide:    1280 – 1535px → centred container (max 1280px)
  Ultra‑wide: 1536px+    → centre content, never full‑width stretch

  Fluid typography: use clamp() – e.g., font‑size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.25rem)

  LAW 13:  Colour must never be the only way to convey information.
  LAW 14:  All images must have descriptive alt text (decorative: alt="").

RESPONSIVE:
  LAW 15:  Mobile design FIRST – then adapt to larger screens.
  LAW 16:  Test at 320px (small mobile), 768px (tablet), 1280px (desktop).

QUALITY GATE (Self‑check before any output)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Before outputting ANY mockup, verify:

□ Consistent spacing using 4px/8px grid?
□ Typography hierarchy clear?
□ Colour palette stays inside defined system?
□ All necessary states designed (default, hover, focus, active, loading, error, empty)?
□ Responsive versions for mobile (375px), tablet (768px), desktop (1280px)?
□ Dark mode variant (if requested)?
□ Primary action obvious?
□ User knows WHERE they are (navigation clues)?
□ Error states with resolution steps?
□ Loading states (skeleton or spinner)?
□ Empty states with CTA?
□ Colour contrast ≥4.5:1 normal text?
□ Touch targets ≥44×44px mobile?
□ Focus indicators visible?
□ Information not conveyed by colour alone?
□ Edge cases (long text, empty data, max items) designed?
□ Annotations explain every important decision?

If ANY answer is NO → Fix before outputting.

║  📐 SECTION 4: UX PATTERNS & STATE REQUIREMENTS                           ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

For EVERY mockup screen, you MUST design and include these states:

✓ LOADING STATE          → skeleton screen (shapes mimicking real content) OR centered spinner + loading text
✓ ERROR STATE            → error icon + clear message + action to resolve (e.g., “Retry”)
✓ EMPTY STATE            → illustration/icon + headline + description + primary CTA
✓ SUCCESS STATE          → success icon + confirmation message + suggested next action (toast or inline)
✓ INLINE VALIDATION      → on blur, not on every keystroke: red border + error text below field

INTERACTION STATES for each interactive component:
  Default, Hover, Focus, Active, Disabled, Loading (for buttons)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  🎬 SECTION 5: MICRO‑INTERACTIONS & MOTION (for interactive prototypes)   ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

If you are creating an interactive prototype (clickable), specify these animations:

  Button hover:   translateY(-1px) + shadow increase, 150ms ease‑out
  Button tap:     scale(0.97), 100ms ease‑in
  Card hover:     translateY(-6px) + shadow increase, 300ms ease‑out
  Modal open:     scale(0.95)+opacity(0) → scale(1)+opacity(1), 250ms spring
  Toast message:  slide + fade in, 3s visible, then slide + fade out
  Page transition (if multi‑screen flow): fade or slide, 300‑400ms

  Animation tokens:
    fast: 150ms, base: 300ms, slow: 500ms
    easing: ease‑out‑expo (cubic‑bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1))
    ➡️ ONLY animate transform and opacity (GPU‑accelerated)

  REDUCED MOTION (mandatory):
    @media (prefers‑reduced‑motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; }
    }

╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ACCESSIBILITY – apply to every mockup:

  □ Keyboard reachable – all buttons, links, form fields via Tab (order = visual order)
  □ :focus‑visible outline: 2px solid [primary], 2px offset
  □ All images have meaningful alt text (decorative: alt="")
  □ All form fields have <label> associated (not placeholder alone)
  □ Error messages connected to input via aria‑describedby
  □ Colour is never the only indicator – use icon + text
  □ Touch targets minimum 44×44px on mobile
  □ Skip navigation link (first focusable element)

RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS (design MOBILE first):

  Mobile:   320 – 767px   → single column, hamburger menu, touch targets ≥44px
  Tablet:   768 – 1023px  → 2 columns, side‑by‑side cards
  Desktop:  1024 – 1279px → full multi‑column, hover effects active
  Wide:     1280 – 1535px → centred container (max 1280px)
  Ultra‑wide: 1536px+     → centre content, never full‑width stretch

  Use fluid typography: font‑size: clamp(min, 2vw, max)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

VISUAL & LAYOUT:
  LAW 1:   NEVER use more than 2‑3 fonts in a design system.
  LAW 2:   NEVER use more than 3 primary colours in the palette.
  LAW 3:   NEVER use arbitrary spacing – always use 4px/8px grid.

  LAW 6:   NEVER design for desktop only – mobile‑first always.

COMPONENTS & STATES:
  LAW 7:   EVERY interactive element must have default, hover, focus, active, disabled states.
  LAW 8:   EVERY screen must have loading, error, empty, and success states.
  LAW 9:   EVERY form input must have a visible label (never placeholder as label).
  LAW 10:  EVERY primary action must be visually prominent and obvious.
  LAW 11:  EVERY form must show inline validation with clear error messages.

ACCESSIBILITY:
  LAW 12:  Focus indicators must be visible (2px outline, 2px offset).
  LAW 13:  Touch targets must be ≥44×44px on mobile.
  LAW 14:  Colour must never be the only way to convey information.
  LAW 15:  All non‑decorative images must have meaningful alt text.

RESPONSIVE & CONSISTENCY:
  LAW 16:  Designs must work at 320px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1280px (desktop).
  LAW 17:  Dark mode must be provided if requested (with proper contrast).
  LAW 18:  Design system must use CSS custom properties for theming.

Prompts I used in my demo:
Shape Morph Ring Animation
Using /hyperframes, create a 5-second seamless looping video (1080x1920, 30fps) of a shape-morphing ring animation centered on screen. Background is a soft mint green (#B8E6C8). The shapes are a deep forest green (#1B4332).
Setup: 8 identical shapes are arranged in a circle around the center point, evenly spaced at 45° intervals. Each shape is positioned on the ring at a consistent radius from center. The entire ring rotates slowly and continuously clockwise (one full rotation takes ~10 seconds, so across the 5-second loop it completes a half turn). Each individual shape also rotates on its own axis, always facing tangentially along the ring.
The morph sequence plays continuously across the 5 seconds. The shapes transition smoothly through these geometric forms in order, blending fluidly between each:
Phase 1 (0s–0.6s) — Diamonds/Rosette: 8 shapes start as a mix of squares and 45°-rotated diamonds arranged tightly, edges nearly touching, forming an 8-pointed star cutout in the negative space at center. Alternating shapes are rotated 45° relative to their neighbors.
Phase 2 (0.6s–1.2s) — Organic Blobs: Corners round dramatically. Shapes become soft organic blobs with high border-radius. They overlap slightly, creating a scalloped flower ring.
Phase 3 (1.2s–1.8s) — Teardrops/Petals: Shapes elongate into teardrop forms, pointed end facing center, round end facing outward. Arranged in a pinwheel — each petal tilted slightly clockwise, creating a spinning flower/windmill pattern.
Phase 4 (1.8s–2.5s) — Leaves: Shapes shrink slightly and morph into leaf/marquise shapes (pointed at both ends). The ring radius expands so there are visible gaps between each leaf. Individual rotation continues.
Phase 5 (2.5s–3.2s) — Semicircles: Shapes morph into half-circles, flat edge facing inward, round edge facing outward. Arranged in a gear-like ring pattern. Ring radius contracts slightly.
Phase 6 (3.2s–3.8s) — Rounded Triangles: Shapes become guitar-pick / rounded-triangle forms, still rotating individually, creating a turbine-like pattern.
Phase 7 (3.8s–4.3s) — Squares: Shapes grow into larger rounded squares, spread out on a wider ring radius. Each square is slightly rotated on its own axis, creating a loose octagonal arrangement. A faint thin circular guide line may be visible behind the shapes.
Phase 8 (4.3s–5.0s) — Arrows: Shapes morph into arrow/chevron shapes pointing inward toward center, tightly packed, forming a starburst/snowflake pattern with a star-shaped cutout in the negative space. This transitions seamlessly back to Phase 1 for the loop.
Key motion principles:
All shape morphs use smooth easing (power2.inOut) — no hard cuts between forms
The ring rotation is constant and linear (no easing) for a hypnotic feel
Individual shape rotation is slightly faster than ring rotation
The ring radius subtly breathes — expanding during looser arrangements (leaves, squares) and contracting during tighter ones (rosette, arrows)
The morph between shapes should animate border-radius, scale, aspect ratio, and rotation simultaneously
Implementation note: Each of the 8 shapes can be a single div with CSS transforms (translate for ring position, rotate for individual angle) and animated border-radius / width / height / clip-path for the shape morphing. Use GSAP timeline with morphSVG or clip-path interpolation for the shape transitions. Export as MP4 for Instagram Reel.
Infinite Horizontal Carousel
Using /hyperframes, create a 5-second seamless looping video (1080x1080, 30fps) of an infinite horizontal carousel showcasing Instagram post thumbnails inside phone-shaped frames.
Background: Soft warm off-white (#F0EDE8), flat, no texture.
Card structure: 3 phone-shaped cards are visible at all times, arranged horizontally across the center of the frame. Each card is a tall rounded rectangle (aspect ratio approximately 9:16, roughly 320px wide × 570px tall at base scale) with large rounded corners (24px radius). Each card displays one of the user-provided Instagram thumbnail images as its full-bleed background, scaled to cover/fill the card with object-fit: cover.
Card hierarchy — center vs sides:
The center card is the hero: scaled up slightly (scale: 1.05), vertically centered in the frame, with a subtle phone notch detail (a small centered pill shape, ~60px wide × 6px tall, dark semi-transparent) near the top edge inside the card, and a faint drop shadow (0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)).
The side cards (left and right) are slightly smaller (scale: 0.95), shifted down ~8px from center, no notch detail, and slightly lower opacity (0.9). They are partially cropped by the frame edges — about 30–40% of each side card is clipped off-screen.
Gap between cards: ~24px spacing.
Animation — constant horizontal scroll:
All cards translate continuously to the left at a constant linear speed (no easing — smooth, machine-like drift).
The scroll speed is calibrated so that one full card-width passes every ~1.7 seconds — across the 5-second loop, all thumbnails cycle through the center position and the final frame matches the first frame exactly for a seamless loop.
As a card exits the left edge, it reappears on the right edge (infinite scroll behavior). Duplicate the card set so there are always cards entering from the right to fill the frame.
The scale, opacity, shadow, and notch of each card should animate smoothly as it transitions between "side" and "center" positions — scaling up as it approaches center, scaling back down as it leaves. Use a smooth power2.inOut ease for the scale/opacity transitions tied to X position.
Thumbnail slots: The composition should support [INSERT NUMBER] thumbnail images. Each image fills its card completely as a background. User will provide the actual image files — use placeholder colored rectangles during first draft (use distinct colors per card so positions are easy to track: e.g., card 1 = coral #FF6B6B, card 2 = sky blue #4ECDC4, card 3 = warm yellow #FFE66D, card 4 = lavender #A8A4CE, etc.).
Mood: Clean, professional, satisfying — like a polished portfolio presentation or an app store feature carousel. The motion should feel effortless and continuous, not snappy or rushed. No text overlays on the cards, no UI chrome beyond the phone notch. No voiceover. Export as MP4 for Instagram Reel.

# ✅ **EXTRACTED CONTENT (FROM IMAGE)**
## **“8 ChatGPT Prompt Frameworks To Help You Master AI”**
## **1. R-T-F (Role – Task – Format)**
**R (Role):** Specify the role you want the AI to assume
**T (Task):** Define the task you want AI to perform
**F (Format):** Indicate the output format
**Example:**
* Role → Act as a brand strategist
* Task → Write a messaging hierarchy for a B2B SaaS founder targeting finance teams
* Format → Bullet points with core message, value props, proof, and CTAs
## **2. S-O-L-V-E (Situation – Objective – Limitations – Vision – Execution)**
**S (Situation):** Define the context
**O (Objective):** Specify goals
**L (Limitations):** Define constraints
**V (Vision):** Outline long-term goal
**E (Execution):** Plan steps
**Example:**
* Situation → Leading content team at startup launching product
* Objective → Generate qualified inbound leads
* Limitations → No ad spend, small team
* Vision → Become go-to thought leader
* Execution → Weekly content + double down on best content
## **3. T-A-G (Task – Action – Goal)**
**T (Task):** Define task
**A (Action):** State action needed
**G (Goal):** Clarify desired outcome
**Example:**
* Task → Reduce customer churn
* Action → Analyze churn + retention program
* Goal → Improve retention by 15% in 6 months
## **4. R-A-C-E (Role – Action – Context – Expectation)**
**R (Role):** Character AI plays
**A (Action):** What to do
**C (Context):** Background info
**E (Expectation):** Desired output
**Example:**
* Role → B2B consultant
* Action → Build outreach framework
* Context → Workflow software for logistics firms
* Expectation → 3 templates tailored to buyer roles
## **5. D-R-E-A-M (Define – Research – Execute – Analyse – Measure)**
**D:** Define problem
**R:** Research
**E:** Execute
**A:** Analyse
**M:** Measure
**Example:**
* Define → Declining retention
* Research → CRM + interviews
* Execute → Retention program
* Analyse → Behavior comparison
* Measure → Churn rate, usage, NPS
## **6. P-A-C-T (Problem – Approach – Compromise – Test)**
**P:** Define problem
**A:** Approach
**C:** Trade-offs
**T:** Testing/measurement
**Example:**
* Problem → Low conversion
* Approach → Improve onboarding
* Compromise → Delay feature rollout
* Test → A/B testing
## **7. C-A-R-E (Context – Action – Result – Example)**
**C:** Context
**A:** Action
**R:** Result
**E:** Example
**Example:**
* Context → Low onboarding engagement
* Action → Redesign onboarding
* Result → Higher adoption
* Example → Activation increased from 25% → 42%
## **8. R-I-S-E (Role – Input – Steps – Expectation)**
**R:** Role
**I:** Input
**S:** Steps
**E:** Expectation
**Example:**
* Role → Commercial director
* Input → Sales data
* Steps → Identify weak points
* Expectation → Growth strategy

# 🔷 **1. RTF → INPUT-OUTPUT CONTROL SYSTEM**

**Instruction Mapping System**
### ⚙️ How it works:

**Decision + Planning System**

```javascript
// GSAP Master Setup for Rent & Lease Dashboard
import { gsap } from "gsap";
import { ScrollTrigger } from "gsap/ScrollTrigger";
import { TextPlugin } from "gsap/TextPlugin";

gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, TextPlugin);

// ── Stat Counter Animation (Dashboard KPIs) ──
function animateCounters() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(el => {
    const target = parseInt(el.dataset.count);
    gsap.from({ val: 0 }, {
      val: target,
      duration: 2,
      ease: "power2.out",
      onUpdate: function() {
        el.textContent = Math.round(this.targets()[0].val).toLocaleString();
      }
    });
  });
}

// ── Card Entrance Animation ──
gsap.fromTo(".metric-card", 
  { opacity: 0, y: 40, scale: 0.95 },
  {
    opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1,
    duration: 0.6,
    stagger: 0.1,
    ease: "back.out(1.4)",
    scrollTrigger: {
      trigger: ".metrics-grid",
      start: "top 80%",
      toggleActions: "play none none reverse"
    }
  }
);

// ── Sidebar Link Hover Glow ──
document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-link').forEach(link => {
  link.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
    gsap.to(link, {
      x: 6,
      duration: 0.2,
      ease: "power2.out"
    });
  });
  link.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
    gsap.to(link, { x: 0, duration: 0.2 });
  });
});

// ── Page Transition Master Timeline ──
export const pageEnter = () => {
  const tl = gsap.timeline();
  tl.from(".page-header", { opacity: 0, y: -20, duration: 0.4 })
    .from(".page-content > *", {
      opacity: 0, y: 30,
      stagger: 0.08,
      duration: 0.5,
      ease: "power3.out"
    }, "-=0.2");
  return tl;
};
```

```javascript
// Framer Motion — Reusable Animated Card Component
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";

// Animation Variants (reuse across all 14 pages)
export const cardVariants = {
  hidden:  { opacity: 0, y: 20, scale: 0.96 },
  visible: {
    opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1,
    transition: { type: "spring", stiffness: 300, damping: 24 }
  },
  exit:    { opacity: 0, y: -10, scale: 0.96 }
};

export const containerVariants = {
  hidden:  { opacity: 0 },
  visible: {
    opacity: 1,
    transition: { staggerChildren: 0.1, delayChildren: 0.2 }
  }
};

export const slideInLeft = {
  hidden:  { opacity: 0, x: -60 },
  visible: { opacity: 1, x: 0, transition: { type: "spring", stiffness: 260 } }
};

// ── Animated Metric Card ──
export function MetricCard({ title, value, change, icon }) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      className="metric-card"
      variants={cardVariants}
      initial="hidden"
      animate="visible"
      exit="exit"
      whileHover={{ 
        y: -4, 
        boxShadow: "0 0 40px rgba(99,102,241,0.3)",
        transition: { duration: 0.2 }
      }}
      whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}
    >
      <motion.span 
        className="metric-value"
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.5 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        transition={{ delay: 0.3, type: "spring" }}
      >
        {value}
      </motion.span>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

// ── Page Transition Wrapper ──
export function PageWrapper({ children }) {
  return (
    <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, filter: "blur(8px)" }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, filter: "blur(8px)" }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.35, ease: [0.4, 0, 0.2, 1] }}
      >
        {children}
      </motion.div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import * as THREE from 'three';

// ── Dashboard Hero: Animated 3D Globe/Mesh ──
class DashboardBackground {
  constructor(container) {
    this.scene    = new THREE.Scene();
    this.camera   = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, 
      container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    this.renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ 
      alpha: true, antialias: true 
    });
    
    this.renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    this.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    container.appendChild(this.renderer.domElement);
    
    // Wireframe sphere for premium feel
    const geometry = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(2, 4);
    const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x6366F1,
      wireframe: true,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.15,
    });
    
    this.mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
    this.scene.add(this.mesh);
    
    // Ambient + point lights
    this.scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x6366F1, 0.5));
    const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x8B5CF6, 2, 10);
    pointLight.position.set(3, 3, 3);
    this.scene.add(pointLight);
    
    this.camera.position.z = 5;
    this.animate();
  }
  
  animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => this.animate());
    this.mesh.rotation.x += 0.002;
    this.mesh.rotation.y += 0.003;
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
  }
}

// Initialize on dashboard
const hero = document.querySelector('#hero-3d');
if (hero) new DashboardBackground(hero);
```

```javascript
import Particles, { initParticlesEngine } from "@tsparticles/react";
import { loadSlim } from "@tsparticles/slim";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

// ── Dashboard Particle Background ──
export function ParticleBackground() {
  const [init, setInit] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    initParticlesEngine(async (engine) => {
      await loadSlim(engine);
    }).then(() => setInit(true));
  }, []);

  const options = {
    background:   { color: { value: "transparent" } },
    fpsLimit:     60,
    interactivity: {
      events: {
        onHover: { enable: true, mode: "repulse" },
        onClick: { enable: true, mode: "push" },
      },
      modes: {
        repulse: { distance: 100, duration: 0.4 },
        push:    { quantity: 3 },
      },
    },
    particles: {
      color:   { value: ["#6366F1", "#8B5CF6", "#06B6D4"] },
      links: {
        color:     "#6366F1",
        distance:  150,
        enable:    true,
        opacity:   0.15,
        width:     1,
      },
      move: {
        direction: "none",
        enable:    true,
        outModes:  { default: "bounce" },
        random:    false,
        speed:     0.8,
        straight:  false,
      },
      number:  { density: { enable: true }, value: 60 },
      opacity: { value: 0.3 },
      shape:   { type: "circle" },
      size:    { value: { min: 1, max: 3 } },
    },
    detectRetina: true,
  };

  if (!init) return null;
  return (
    <Particles
      id="tsparticles"
      options={options}
      style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, zIndex: 0 }}
    />
  );
}
```

## 3.2 React Spring (Physics-based)

```bash
npm install @react-spring/web
```

```javascript
import { useSpring, animated, useTrail } from "@react-spring/web";

// ── Animated Number Ticker (Dashboard KPIs) ──
function AnimatedStat({ value, prefix = "", suffix = "" }) {
  const { number } = useSpring({
    from:   { number: 0 },
    to:     { number: value },
    config: { mass: 1, tension: 80, friction: 20 },
    delay:  300,
  });
  return (
    <animated.span>
      {number.to(n => `${prefix}${Math.floor(n).toLocaleString()}${suffix}`)}
    </animated.span>
  );
}

// ── Staggered Trail Animation (Tenant List) ──
function TenantList({ tenants }) {
  const trail = useTrail(tenants.length, {
    from: { opacity: 0, transform: "translate3d(-20px,0,0)" },
    to:   { opacity: 1, transform: "translate3d(0,0,0)" },
    config: { tension: 280, friction: 22 },
  });
  
  return trail.map((style, i) => (
    <animated.div key={tenants[i].id} style={style} className="tenant-row">
      {tenants[i].name}
    </animated.div>
  ));
}
```

# 📜 PART 4: SCROLL EFFECTS

## 4.1 Locomotive Scroll + GSAP ScrollTrigger

```bash
npm install locomotive-scroll gsap
```

```javascript
import LocomotiveScroll from 'locomotive-scroll';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';
import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger';

gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

// ── Premium Smooth Scroll Setup ──
const locoScroll = new LocomotiveScroll({
  el:        document.querySelector("[data-scroll-container]"),
  smooth:    true,
  multiplier: 0.8,
  class:     "is-inview",
});

// Sync Locomotive with GSAP ScrollTrigger
locoScroll.on("scroll", ScrollTrigger.update);

ScrollTrigger.scrollerProxy("[data-scroll-container]", {
  scrollTop(value) {
    return arguments.length
      ? locoScroll.scrollTo(value, { duration: 0, disableLerp: true })
      : locoScroll.scroll.instance.scroll.y;
  },
  getBoundingClientRect() {
    return { top: 0, left: 0, 
             width: window.innerWidth, 
             height: window.innerHeight };
  },
});

// ── Parallax Hero Section ──
gsap.to(".hero-visual", {
  yPercent: -30,
  ease:     "none",
  scrollTrigger: {
    trigger: ".hero",
    start:   "top top",
    end:     "bottom top",
    scrub:   true,
    scroller: "[data-scroll-container]",
  }
});

// ── Stats Counter on Scroll ──
gsap.from(".stat-number", {
  textContent: 0,
  duration:    2,
  ease:        "power1.in",
  snap:        { textContent: 1 },
  stagger:     0.2,
  scrollTrigger: {
    trigger:  ".stats-section",
    start:    "top 80%",
  }
});
```

# 📱 PART 2: RESPONSIVE GRID SYSTEM

```
BREAKPOINTS:
├── Mobile:  < 768px   → Sidebar collapses to bottom nav
├── Tablet:  768-1024px → Sidebar icon-only (60px)
├── Desktop: 1024-1440px → Full sidebar (260px)
└── Wide:    > 1440px  → Full sidebar + wider content

CONTENT GRID (inside main area):
├── Padding:  24px (desktop) / 16px (tablet) / 12px (mobile)
├── Gap:      16px
└── Columns:  12-column grid (CSS Grid)
```

```html
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
     RENT & LEASE — COMPLETE LIBRARY STACK
     All CDN links versioned & production-ready
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

<!-- FONTS -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:ital,opsz,wght@0,14..32,300;0,14..32,400;0,14..32,500;0,14..32,600;0,14..32,700;0,14..32,800;0,14..32,900&family=Sora:wght@600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<!-- ICONS: Remixicon -->
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/remixicon@4.2.0/fonts/remixicon.css" rel="stylesheet">

<!-- ── MOTION & ANIMATION ── -->

<!-- GSAP Core + Plugins (Industry Standard) -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/gsap.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/TextPlugin.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/Flip.min.js"></script>

<!-- AOS: Animate On Scroll (CSS scroll effects) -->
<link  href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/aos@2.3.4/dist/aos.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/aos@2.3.4/dist/aos.js"></script>

<!-- ── 3D GRAPHICS ── -->
<!-- Three.js -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.165.0/build/three.min.js"></script>

<!-- ── PARTICLES ── -->
<!-- tsParticles -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tsparticles@3.5.0/tsparticles.bundle.min.js"></script>

<!-- ── CHARTS ── -->
<!-- Chart.js -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.3/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>

<!-- ── DRAG & DROP ── -->
<!-- SortableJS (Kanban) -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@1.15.2/Sortable.min.js"></script>

<!-- ── UI COMPONENTS ── -->
<!-- Alpine.js (reactivity) -->
<script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.14.1/dist/cdn.min.js"></script>

<!-- Tippy.js (Tooltips) -->
<link href="https://unpkg.com/tippy.js@6/dist/tippy.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/@popperjs/core@2/dist/umd/popper.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/tippy.js@6/dist/tippy-bundle.umd.js"></script>

<!-- Notyf (Toast Notifications) -->
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/notyf@3/notyf.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/notyf@3/notyf.min.js"></script>

<!-- ── INITIALIZATION ── -->
<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    // AOS
    AOS.init({
      duration:   600,
      easing:     'cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)',
      once:       false,
      mirror:     true,
      offset:     60
    });

    // GSAP Plugins
    gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, TextPlugin, Flip);

    // Global page entrance
    gsap.fromTo('main > *',
      { opacity: 0, y: 24 },
      { opacity: 1, y: 0, stagger: 0.08,
        duration: 0.5, ease: 'power3.out', delay: 0.1 }
    );

    // Tooltips
    tippy('[data-tippy-content]', { theme: 'custom', animation: 'shift-away' });

    // Toast
    window.toast = new Notyf({
      duration: 4000,
      position: { x: 'right', y: 'top' },
      types: [
        { type: 'success', background: '#10B981' },
        { type: 'error',   background: '#EF4444' }
      ]
    });
  });
</script>
```

# 🎨 PART 6: DESIGN SYSTEM TOKEN FILE

**Save as: `docs/design-system.md`**

```markdown
# Rent & Lease Management — Design System v1.0
# Premium Dark SaaS Theme | Property Management

You are building a Property Management SaaS with a 
Premium Dark Futuristic visual identity.
Linear.app meets Stripe Dashboard meets Apple Vision Pro.

## Color Palette
- Primary:    #6366F1  — Indigo (CTAs, active, links)
- Secondary:  #8B5CF6  — Violet (gradients, accents)
- Accent:     #06B6D4  — Cyan (live indicators, info)
- Background: #0A0A0F  — Deep Space Black
- Surface:    #111118  — Dark Navy (cards)
- Surface-2:  #1A1A2E  — Elevated (hover states)
- Text:       #F8FAFC  — Primary text
- Text-2:     #94A3B8  — Secondary text
- Border:     #1E293B  — Dividers
- Success:    #10B981  — Emerald
- Warning:    #F59E0B  — Amber
- Error:      #EF4444  — Red

## Typography
- UI:      Inter (300/400/500/600/700/800/900)
- Display: Sora (600/700/800) — headings only
- Mono:    JetBrains Mono (400/600) — numbers/code
- Scale:   11/12/14/16/18/20/24/32/40/48/64/80px

## Spacing (4px base)
4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 80, 96, 128px

## Border Radius
- XS (badges):   4px
- SM (inputs):   8px
- MD (cards):    12px
- LG (modals):   16px
- XL (hero):     24px
- Full:          9999px

## Shadows
- Subtle:  0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)
- Medium:  0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)
- Strong:  0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)
- Glow:    0 0 40px rgba(99,102,241,0.3)

## Animation Timing
- Fast:   150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)
- Base:   250ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)
- Slow:   400ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)
- Spring: cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)

## Rules
1. Never use colors outside this palette
2. Always use spacing scale — no arbitrary values
3. All interactive elements get hover + active states
4. Minimum 44px touch target on all clickables
5. All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion
6. All text meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios
7. Cards always use gradient-surface background
8. Primary buttons always have glow shadow on hover
```

## 1.4 JavaScript Interaction System

```javascript
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
   INTERACTION SYSTEM — RENT & LEASE MANAGEMENT
   All JS interactions for 14 pages
   Libraries: GSAP + Alpine.js + SortableJS + Chart.js
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

// ── GSAP Plugin Registration ──
gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, TextPlugin, Flip);

// ════════════════════════════════════
// 1. PAGE ENTRANCE ANIMATION
// Runs on every page load
// ════════════════════════════════════
class PageAnimator {
  static init() {
    const tl = gsap.timeline({ defaults: { ease: 'power3.out' } });

    // Sidebar links stagger
    tl.fromTo('.sidebar-link',
      { opacity: 0, x: -16 },
      { opacity: 1, x: 0, stagger: 0.04, duration: 0.4 }, 0);

    // Navbar
    tl.fromTo('.navbar',
      { opacity: 0, y: -20 },
      { opacity: 1, y: 0,  duration: 0.4 }, 0.1);

    // Page header
    tl.fromTo('.page-header',
      { opacity: 0, y: 24 },
      { opacity: 1, y: 0,  duration: 0.5 }, 0.2);

    // Page content children
    tl.fromTo('.page-content > *',
      { opacity: 0, y: 32 },
      { opacity: 1, y: 0, stagger: 0.08, duration: 0.5 }, 0.3);

    return tl;
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════
// 2. METRIC CARD COUNTER ANIMATION
// Dashboard KPIs: 0 → value spring
// ════════════════════════════════════
class MetricCounter {
  static init() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach((el, i) => {
      const target   = parseFloat(el.dataset.count);
      const prefix   = el.dataset.prefix   || '';
      const suffix   = el.dataset.suffix   || '';
      const decimals = el.dataset.decimals || 0;

      ScrollTrigger.create({
        trigger: el,
        start:   'top 90%',
        once:    true,
        onEnter: () => {
          gsap.fromTo(
            { value: 0 },
            {
              value:    target,
              duration: 2,
              delay:    i * 0.1,
              ease:     'power2.out',
              onUpdate: function() {
                const v = this.targets()[0].value;
                el.textContent = prefix +
                  (decimals > 0
                    ? v.toFixed(decimals)
                    : Math.round(v).toLocaleString()) +
                  suffix;
              }
            }
          );
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════
// 3. CARD SCROLL ANIMATIONS
// AOS-style using GSAP ScrollTrigger
// ════════════════════════════════════
class ScrollAnimator {
  static init() {
    // Fade up cards
    gsap.utils.toArray('[data-aos="fade-up"]').forEach((el, i) => {
      gsap.fromTo(el,
        { opacity: 0, y: 40 },
        {
          opacity: 1, y: 0,
          duration: 0.6,
          delay: (el.dataset.aosDelay || 0) / 1000,
          ease: 'power3.out',
          scrollTrigger: {
            trigger: el,
            start:   'top 85%',
            toggleActions: 'play none none reverse'
          }
        }
      );
    });

    // Fade left
    gsap.utils.toArray('[data-aos="fade-left"]').forEach(el => {
      gsap.fromTo(el,
        { opacity: 0, x: 40 },
        {
          opacity: 1, x: 0,
          duration: 0.6,
          ease: 'power3.out',
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: 'top 85%' }
        }
      );
    });

    // Scale in
    gsap.utils.toArray('[data-aos="zoom-in"]').forEach(el => {
      gsap.fromTo(el,
        { opacity: 0, scale: 0.88 },
        {
          opacity: 1, scale: 1,
          duration: 0.5,
          ease: 'back.out(1.4)',
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: 'top 85%' }
        }
      );
    });
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════
// 4. MODAL SYSTEM
// Open, close, keyboard trap
// ════════════════════════════════════
class ModalManager {
  static open(modalId) {
    const overlay = document.getElementById(modalId);
    if (!overlay) return;

    overlay.style.display = 'flex';
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    gsap.fromTo(overlay,
      { opacity: 0 },
      { opacity: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out' }
    );

    const modal = overlay.querySelector('.modal');
    gsap.fromTo(modal,
      { opacity: 0, scale: 0.92, y: 16 },
      { opacity: 1, scale: 1,    y: 0,
        duration: 0.35, ease: 'back.out(1.4)' }
    );

    // Trap focus
    const focusable = modal.querySelectorAll(
      'button, input, select, textarea, a[href], [tabindex]'
    );
    if (focusable.length) focusable[0].focus();

    // Close on overlay click
    overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === overlay) ModalManager.close(modalId);
    });

    // Close on Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') ModalManager.close(modalId);
    }, { once: true });
  }

  static close(modalId) {
    const overlay = document.getElementById(modalId);
    if (!overlay) return;

    const modal = overlay.querySelector('.modal');
    gsap.to(modal, {
      opacity: 0, scale: 0.94, y: 8,
      duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.in'
    });

    gsap.to(overlay, {
      opacity: 0,
      duration: 0.25,
      ease: 'power2.in',
      onComplete: () => {
        overlay.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      }
    });
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════
// 5. SIDEBAR ACTIVE STATE
// Set active link based on URL
// ════════════════════════════════════
class SidebarManager {
  static init() {
    const current = window.location.pathname;
    document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-link').forEach(link => {
      if (link.getAttribute('href') === current) {
        link.classList.add('active');
      }
    });

    // Hover micro-animation
    document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar-link').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
        if (!link.classList.contains('active')) {
          gsap.to(link, { x: 4, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out' });
        }
      });
      link.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
        if (!link.classList.contains('active')) {
          gsap.to(link, { x: 0, duration: 0.15 });
        }
      });
    });
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════
// 6. TOAST NOTIFICATION SYSTEM
// ════════════════════════════════════
class Toast {
  static container = null;

  static init() {
    this.container = document.createElement('div');
    this.container.style.cssText = `
      position: fixed; top: 24px; right: 24px;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;
      z-index: 500; pointer-events: none;
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(this.container);
  }

  static show(message, type = 'info', duration = 4000) {
    const colors = {
      success: { bg: '#10B981', icon: '✓' },
      error:   { bg: '#EF4444', icon: '✕' },
      warning: { bg: '#F59E0B', icon: '⚠' },
      info:    { bg: '#6366F1', icon: 'ℹ' },
    };

    const config = colors[type] || colors.info;
    const toast = document.createElement('div');

    toast.style.cssText = `
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 20px; min-width: 320px; max-width: 420px;
      background: #111118; border: 1px solid #1E293B;
      border-left: 3px solid ${config.bg};
      border-radius: 12px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      pointer-events: all; cursor: pointer;
      font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px; color: #F8FAFC;
    `;

    toast.innerHTML = `
      <span style="width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;
        background:${config.bg};display:flex;align-items:center;
        justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
        flex-shrink:0;color:white;">${config.icon}</span>
      <span style="flex:1;">${message}</span>
      <span style="color:#64748B;font-size:18px;">×</span>
    `;

    this.container.appendChild(toast);
    toast.addEventListener('click', () => this.dismiss(toast));

    gsap.fromTo(toast,
      { opacity: 0, x: 40, scale: 0.95 },
      { opacity: 1, x: 0,  scale: 1,
        duration: 0.35, ease: 'back.out(1.4)' }
    );

    setTimeout(() => this.dismiss(toast), duration);
  }

  static dismiss(toast) {
    gsap.to(toast, {
      opacity: 0, x: 40, scale: 0.95,
      duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.in',
      onComplete: () => toast.remove()
    });
  }

  static success(msg, dur) { this.show(msg, 'success', dur); }
  static error(msg, dur)   { this.show(msg, 'error',   dur); }
  static warning(msg, dur) { this.show(msg, 'warning', dur); }
  static info(msg, dur)    { this.show(msg, 'info',    dur); }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════
// 7. KANBAN DRAG & DROP (Maintenance)
// Using SortableJS
// ════════════════════════════════════
class KanbanBoard {
  static init() {
    const columns = document.querySelectorAll('.kanban-column-body');

    columns.forEach(col => {
      new Sortable(col, {
        group:     'kanban',
        animation: 200,
        ghostClass: 'ticket-ghost',
        chosenClass: 'ticket-chosen',
        dragClass:  'ticket-dragging',
        easing:    'cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)',

        onStart: ({ item }) => {
          gsap.to(item, {
            rotation: 2, scale: 1.03, opacity: 0.8,
            duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out'
          });
        },

        onEnd: ({ item, to }) => {
          gsap.to(item, {
            rotation: 0, scale: 1, opacity: 1,
            duration: 0.3, ease: 'back.out(1.4)'
          });

          const newStatus = to.dataset.status;
          const ticketId  = item.dataset.id;

          // API call to update status
          fetch(`/api/v1/maintenance/${ticketId}/`, {
            method:  'PATCH',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'X-CSRFToken':  getCookie('csrftoken')
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ status: newStatus })
          })
          .then(() => {
            Toast.success(`Ticket moved to ${newStatus}`);
            KanbanBoard.updateCounts();
          })
          .catch(() => Toast.error('Failed to update ticket status'));
        }
      });
    });
  }

  static updateCounts() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.kanban-column').forEach(col => {
      const count = col.querySelectorAll('.ticket-card').length;
      const badge = col.querySelector('.column-count');
      if (badge) {
        gsap.fromTo(badge,
          { scale: 1.3 },
          { scale: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: 'back.out(2)' }
        );
        badge.textContent = count;
      }
    });
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════
// 9. DROPDOWN SYSTEM
// ════════════════════════════════════
class DropdownManager {
  static init() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-dropdown]').forEach(trigger => {
      const targetId = trigger.dataset.dropdown;
      const target   = document.getElementById(targetId);
      if (!target) return;

      let isOpen = false;

      trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        isOpen ? this.close(target) : this.open(target);
        isOpen = !isOpen;
      });

      document.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (isOpen) { this.close(target); isOpen = false; }
      });
    });
  }

  static open(el) {
    el.style.display = 'block';
    gsap.fromTo(el,
      { opacity: 0, y: -8, scale: 0.96 },
      { opacity: 1, y: 0,  scale: 1,
        duration: 0.2, ease: 'back.out(1.4)' }
    );
  }

  static close(el) {
    gsap.to(el, {
      opacity: 0, y: -8, scale: 0.96,
      duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.in',
      onComplete: () => { el.style.display = 'none'; }
    });
  }
}

// ════════════════════════════════════
// 11. THREE.JS — Dashboard 3D Hero
// ════════════════════════════════════
function initThreeHero(containerId = 'hero-3d') {
  const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!container) return;

  const scene    = new THREE.Scene();
  const camera   = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
    60, container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight, 0.1, 100
  );
  const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
    alpha: true, antialias: true
  });

  renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
  renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
  container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

  // Icosahedron wireframe
  const geo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(2.5, 3);
  const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color:       0x6366F1,
    wireframe:   true,
    transparent: true,
    opacity:     0.12,
  });
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  scene.add(mesh);

  // Point cloud
  const pts = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  const pArr = new Float32Array(300 * 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < 300 * 3; i++) pArr[i] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
  pts.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pArr, 3));
  const ptMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
    color: 0x8B5CF6, size: 0.04, transparent: true, opacity: 0.4
  });
  scene.add(new THREE.Points(pts, ptMat));

  // Lights
  scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x6366F1, 0.5));
  const pLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x8B5CF6, 2, 15);
  pLight.position.set(4, 4, 4);
  scene.add(pLight);

  camera.position.z = 6;

  // Mouse parallax
  let mx = 0, my = 0;
  window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    mx = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth  - 0.5) * 2;
    my = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 2;
  });

  function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    mesh.rotation.x += 0.003;
    mesh.rotation.y += 0.004;
    camera.position.x += (mx * 0.5 - camera.position.x) * 0.05;
    camera.position.y += (-my * 0.5 - camera.position.y) * 0.05;
    camera.lookAt(scene.position);
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
  }
  animate();

  // Responsive resize
  new ResizeObserver(() => {
    camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
  }).observe(container);
}

function getCookie(name) {
  const v = `; ${document.cookie}`.split(`; ${name}=`);
  if (v.length === 2) return v.pop().split(';').shift();
  return '';
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  PageAnimator.init();
  MetricCounter.init();
  ScrollAnimator.init();
  SidebarManager.init();
  DropdownManager.init();
  ChartDefaults.init();
  Toast.init();

  // Page-specific
  if (document.querySelector('.kanban-column-body')) KanbanBoard.init();
  if (document.getElementById('particles'))           initParticles();
  if (document.getElementById('hero-3d'))             initThreeHero();

  // Tooltips
  if (typeof tippy !== 'undefined') {
    tippy('[data-tippy-content]', {
      theme:     'custom',
      animation: 'shift-away',
      arrow:     true,
      delay:     [300, 100],
    });
  }

  // Global keyboard shortcuts
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    // Cmd/Ctrl + K → search
    if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'k') {
      e.preventDefault();
      document.querySelector('.navbar-search')?.focus();
    }
  });
});
```

# 🎨 LAYER 1: STYLING SECURITY

## 1.1 CSS Security — No Data Leakage in Styles

```css
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CSS SECURITY LAYER
   Prevent: CSS injection, data exfiltration via CSS,
            clickjacking, UI redressing attacks
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── 1. Prevent CSS-based data exfiltration ── */
/* Never use attr() to display sensitive data */
/* BAD:  content: attr(data-card-number); */
/* GOOD: Keep sensitive data server-side only */

/* ── 2. Prevent UI Redressing / Clickjacking ── */
/* This is handled at HTTP header level (X-Frame-Options) */
/* But CSS reinforces it: */
body {
  /* Prevent iframe embedding of your pages */
  /* Complemented by: X-Frame-Options: DENY */
  position: relative;
  z-index:  0;
}

/* ── 3. Prevent user-select on sensitive fields ── */
.sensitive-data {
  user-select:     none;     /* Prevent copy of card numbers etc */
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

/* Except where user needs to copy (e.g. account numbers) */
.copyable {
  user-select: text;
  cursor:      copy;
}

/* ── 4. Mask sensitive display data ── */
.data-masked {
  filter:          blur(4px);
  transition:      filter 300ms ease;
  cursor:          pointer;
}

.data-masked:hover,
.data-masked:focus {
  filter: blur(0);
}

/* ── 5. Secure loading states (no flash of sensitive content) ── */
.content-loading {
  visibility: hidden;   /* Hide until auth confirmed */
  opacity:    0;
}

.content-ready {
  visibility: visible;
  opacity:    1;
  transition: opacity 300ms ease;
}

/* ── 6. Prevent drag of sensitive elements ── */
.no-drag {
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
  user-drag:         none;
  -webkit-app-region: no-drag;
}

/* ── 7. Print security — hide sensitive data in print ── */
@media print {
  .no-print,
  .sensitive-data,
  .auth-token,
  .navbar,
  .sidebar,
  [data-sensitive] {
    display: none !important;
  }

  body::before {
    content:     "CONFIDENTIAL — Rent & Lease Management";
    display:     block;
    text-align:  center;
    font-size:   12px;
    color:       #666;
    padding:     8px;
    border:      1px solid #ccc;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
}

/* ── 8. High contrast / forced colors (accessibility + security) ── */
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .btn-primary { forced-color-adjust: none; }
  .badge       { forced-color-adjust: none; }
}

/* ── 9. Prevent CSS history sniffing ── */
/* Do NOT style :visited links differently for security */
a:visited { color: var(--color-text-brand); } /* Same as :link */

/* ── 10. Secure form autofill styling ── */
input:-webkit-autofill,
input:-webkit-autofill:hover,
input:-webkit-autofill:focus {
  /* Override browser autofill yellow background */
  -webkit-box-shadow:      0 0 0 1000px var(--color-surface-2) inset !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--color-text-primary) !important;
  caret-color:             var(--color-text-primary);
  transition:              background-color 5000s ease-in-out 0s;
}
```

# 🏗️ LAYER 2: STRUCTURAL SECURITY

## 2.1 Secure HTML Structure

```html
<!--
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  SECURE HTML TEMPLATE STRUCTURE
  Prevents: XSS, CSRF, Clickjacking, Information Leakage
  Applied to: ALL 14 landlord page templates
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-->
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"
      dir="ltr"
      data-user-role="landlord"
      data-user-id="{{ request.user.id|escapejs }}">
<!--
  SECURITY NOTES:
  1. lang attr prevents screen reader attacks
  2. data-user-role used by JS for client-side role checks
  3. NO sensitive data (tokens, emails) in HTML attributes
  4. data-user-id is non-sensitive (public PK equivalent)
-->

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport"
        content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0,
                 maximum-scale=5.0">

  <!--
    SECURITY HEADERS (also set in Django middleware/nginx):
    These meta tags are SUPPLEMENTARY to HTTP headers.
    HTTP headers always take priority.
  -->

  <!-- Referrer Policy: Don't leak URL to external sites -->
  <meta name="referrer" content="strict-origin-when-cross-origin">

  <!-- Prevent phone number detection (prevents UI manipulation) -->
  <meta name="format-detection"
        content="telephone=no, date=no, email=no, address=no">

  <!-- X-UA-Compatible: Force IE standards mode -->
  <meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge">

  <!--
    CSP: Content Security Policy
    CRITICAL: Also must be set as HTTP header in Django
    This is the most important security header
  -->
  <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"
        content="
          default-src 'self';
          script-src  'self'
                      'nonce-{{ csp_nonce }}'
                      https://cdn.jsdelivr.net
                      https://unpkg.com
                      https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com;
          style-src   'self'
                      'nonce-{{ csp_nonce }}'
                      https://fonts.googleapis.com
                      https://cdn.jsdelivr.net
                      https://unpkg.com;
          font-src    'self'
                      https://fonts.gstatic.com
                      https://cdn.jsdelivr.net;
          img-src     'self'
                      data:
                      https:
                      blob:;
          connect-src 'self'
                      wss://{{ request.get_host }}
                      https://{{ request.get_host }};
          frame-src   'none';
          object-src  'none';
          base-uri    'self';
          form-action 'self';
          upgrade-insecure-requests;
        ">

  <!-- Subresource Integrity (SRI) — verify CDN files -->
  <title>{% block title %}Rent & Lease{% endblock %} | Secure Portal</title>

  <!-- CSRF Token (for AJAX calls) — stored in meta, NOT in DOM text -->
  <meta name="csrf-token" content="{{ csrf_token }}">

  <!-- Load CSS with nonce -->
  <link rel="stylesheet"
        href="{% static 'css/main.css' %}"
        nonce="{{ csp_nonce }}">
</head>

<body class="page-layout"
      data-page="{% block page_name %}{% endblock %}">

  <!-- Skip to main content (accessibility + prevents tab-napping) -->
  <a href="#main-content"
     class="sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:absolute focus:top-4 focus:left-4
            focus:z-50 focus:px-4 focus:py-2 focus:bg-primary focus:text-white
            focus:rounded-md">
    Skip to main content
  </a>

  <!-- Sidebar: role-based rendering -->
  {% if request.user.is_authenticated and request.user.role == 'landlord' %}
  <aside class="sidebar" role="navigation" aria-label="Main navigation">
    <!-- SECURITY: No sensitive data in sidebar -->
    <!-- Sidebar links — all validated server-side -->
    {% include 'landlord/partials/_sidebar.html' %}
  </aside>
  {% endif %}

  <!-- Navbar -->
  <header class="navbar" role="banner">
    {% include 'landlord/partials/_navbar.html' %}
  </header>

  <!-- Main Content -->
  <main id="main-content"
        class="page-main"
        role="main"
        aria-label="{% block aria_label %}Page content{% endblock %}">

    <!-- CSRF Token for forms (Django template tag) -->
    <!-- NOTE: Also present in meta[name=csrf-token] for AJAX -->

    <!-- Flash Messages (Django messages framework) -->
    {% if messages %}
    <div role="alert" aria-live="polite" class="messages-container">
      {% for message in messages %}
      <div class="alert alert-{{ message.tags }}"
           role="{% if message.level >= 40 %}alert{% else %}status{% endif %}">
        <!-- Django auto-escapes message content — XSS safe -->
        {{ message }}
      </div>
      {% endfor %}
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Page Content Block -->
    <div class="page-content">
      {% block content %}{% endblock %}
    </div>

  </main>

  <!-- Scripts at bottom with nonce (CSP compliance) -->
  <script nonce="{{ csp_nonce }}">
    // SECURITY: CSRF token available to all scripts
    // Read from meta tag — NOT from cookie directly
    window.__CSRF__ = document.querySelector(
      'meta[name="csrf-token"]'
    )?.content || '';

    // SECURITY: Never log tokens to console in production
    if (window.location.hostname !== 'localhost') {
      console.log = () => {};
      console.warn = () => {};
      console.error = () => {};
    }
  </script>

  <!-- External scripts with SRI hashes -->
  <script
    src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.12.5/dist/gsap.min.js"
    integrity="sha384-[HASH]"
    crossorigin="anonymous"
    nonce="{{ csp_nonce }}">
  </script>

  <script src="{% static 'js/main.js' %}"
          nonce="{{ csp_nonce }}"
          defer>
  </script>

  {% block extra_js %}{% endblock %}

</body>
</html>
```
