```
║  TRIM: File names stripped, null bytes removed                     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE 9: ANALYTICS — /landlord/analytics/                            ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║  SQL:  All aggregate queries → pure ORM with parameterized filters  ║
║  SQL:  Date range param → validated before queryset filter          ║
║  XSS:  Chart labels from DB → escaped before JS injection          ║
║  XSS:  json_script tag used for Chart.js data                      ║
║  DATA: CSV export → all fields sanitized, no formula injection     ║
║        (Prevent CSV injection: cells starting with =+-@ escaped)   ║
║  TRIM: Period filter params stripped and validated                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE 10: NOTIFICATIONS — /landlord/notifications/                   ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║  SQL:  Feed query → scoped to request.user, paginated              ║
║  XSS:  Notification message text → auto-escaped                    ║
║  XSS:  Notification from WebSocket push → textContent only         ║
║  DATA: Mark-read action → verify notification belongs to user      ║
║  DATA: Pagination params → integer cast, within safe bounds        ║
║  TRIM: Message text trimmed before store                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE 11: SETTINGS — /landlord/settings/                             ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║  SQL:  Profile update → ORM, scoped to request.user only          ║
║  XSS:  Profile data displayed back → auto-escaped                  ║
║  DATA: Password change → current password verified first           ║
║  DATA: New password → full complexity validation                    ║
║  DATA: Bank details → encrypted at rest (EncryptedField)          ║
║  DATA: Email change → re-verification email required               ║
║  DATA: Notification toggles → boolean validation, not truthy       ║
║  TRIM: Name, phone stripped + normalized                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE 12: EXPENSES — /landlord/expenses/                             ║

║  XSS:  Notes, category display → auto-escaped                      ║
```

# 🏠 PART 2: PAGE 1 — DASHBOARD
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: DASHBOARD (/landlord/dashboard/)                              ║
║  PURPOSE: Command center for portfolio health                        ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW D1: LANDLORD MAY ONLY VIEW THEIR OWN PORTFOLIO DATA            ║
║  → Source: Privacy + Data Protection Act 2019                      ║
║  → Enforcement: All metrics filtered to request.user               ║
║  → Scope: Occupied units, revenue, overdue, tickets                ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW D2: REAL-TIME DATA MUST REFLECT ACTUAL DATABASE STATE          ║
║  → Source: Consumer Protection Act — no misleading information     ║
║  → Enforcement: No cached metrics for financial data               ║
║  → Exception: Non-financial counts may cache for 5 minutes         ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE D1: OCCUPANCY CALCULATION                                      ║
║  → Occupied = units with status='active' AND lease.end > today    ║
║  → Vacant   = total units MINUS occupied units                     ║
║  → Occupancy Rate = (Occupied / Total) × 100, rounded to 1 dp     ║
║  → A unit with a future lease start is still VACANT today          ║
║  → A unit with an expired lease is VACANT even if tenant is there ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE D2: EXPECTED VS ACTUAL MONTHLY REVENUE                        ║
║  → Expected = SUM of all active lease monthly rents for this month ║
║  → Actual   = SUM of all PAID invoices for this month              ║
║  → Collection Rate = (Actual / Expected) × 100                    ║
║  → Late fees ARE included in actual collected                      ║
║  → Partial payments count toward actual (record partial amount)   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE D3: OVERDUE RENT DEFINITION                                    ║
║  → Rent is overdue if invoice status = 'unpaid' AND               ║
║    due_date < today AND grace period (5 days) has passed          ║
║  → Overdue count shows NUMBER of overdue invoices (not tenants)   ║
║  → Dashboard highlights if count > 0 with warning color           ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE D4: EXPIRING LEASES ALERT THRESHOLD                           ║
║  → Show leases expiring within 60 days                            ║
║  → CRITICAL: expiring in ≤ 14 days (red alert)                    ║
║  → WARNING:  expiring in 15-30 days (amber alert)                 ║
║  → NOTICE:   expiring in 31-60 days (blue notice)                 ║
║  → Expired leases (past end date) are NOT shown here              ║
║    (they appear in the Leases page as 'expired' status)           ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE D5: OPEN MAINTENANCE TICKETS COUNT                            ║
║  → Count = tickets where status IN ('pending', 'in_progress')     ║
║  → Resolved tickets are NOT counted                                ║
║  → Emergency tickets are highlighted separately                   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE D6: ACTIVITY FEED ORDERING                                     ║
║  → Newest event first (reverse chronological)                     ║
║  → Maximum 20 items in feed                                        ║
║  → Feed includes: payments, late fees, tickets, lease events      ║
║  → Feed is scoped to landlord's properties only                   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LOGIC:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC D1: Dashboard data is read-only                              ║
║  → No form submissions from dashboard                              ║
║  → "Renew" button on expiring leases navigates to Leases page     ║
║  → All action buttons redirect to the relevant page                ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC D2: Metric refresh                                            ║
║  → Financial metrics: real-time (no cache)                         ║
║  → Counts (tickets, leases): may cache for 5 minutes              ║
║  → WebSocket connection shows live activity feed                   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR DASHBOARD:                                    ║
║  ✅ All metrics filtered by landlord=request.user                   ║
║  ✅ No raw SQL in aggregate queries                                  ║
║  ✅ Revenue figures escaped before JS injection into charts         ║
║  ✅ Property/tenant names auto-escaped in template                  ║
║  ✅ Date comparisons use timezone-aware datetime                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# 🏗️ PART 3: PAGE 2 — PROPERTIES
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: PROPERTIES (/landlord/properties/)                            ║
║  PURPOSE: Digital catalog of physical property assets                ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW P1: PROPERTY MUST EXIST LEGALLY BEFORE BEING LISTED            ║
║  → Source: Land Act 2012 — only titled/registered property         ║
║  → Enforcement: Landlord confirms property is legally theirs        ║
║  → System records landlord's assertion (no verification API yet)   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW P2: RENT AMOUNT MUST BE STATED IN LAWFUL CURRENCY             ║
║  → Source: Central Bank of Kenya Act — transactions in KES         ║
║  → Enforcement: Rent stored and displayed in KES only              ║
║  → No foreign currency rent allowed                                ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW P3: PROPERTY CANNOT BE DOUBLE-ASSIGNED                         ║
║  → Source: Law of Contract — cannot lease same unit twice          ║
║  → Enforcement: One active lease per unit at any time              ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE P1: PROPERTY CREATION                                          ║
║  → Name: 2-100 characters, alphanumeric + spaces + hyphens        ║
║  → Address: 5-255 characters, required                             ║
║  → Unit number: 1-20 characters, required                          ║
║  → Monthly rent: KES 1,000 minimum, KES 5,000,000 maximum         ║
║  → Type: must be one of [apartment, house, commercial, land, other]║
║  → Landlord field: automatically set to request.user               ║
║  → Status on create: always 'vacant'                               ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE P2: PROPERTY EDIT RESTRICTIONS                                 ║
║  → Any field can be edited EXCEPT landlord assignment              ║
║  → Rent can be changed BUT new rent only applies to NEXT lease    ║
║  → Rent change does NOT retroactively change existing invoices     ║
║  → Property type cannot be changed if active lease exists         ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE P3: PROPERTY DELETE RESTRICTIONS                               ║
║  → CANNOT delete a property with an ACTIVE lease                  ║
║  → CANNOT delete a property with UNPAID invoices                  ║
║  → CANNOT delete a property with OPEN maintenance tickets          ║
║  → CAN delete a property that is VACANT with no pending issues    ║
║  → Delete is SOFT DELETE — record kept for audit, hidden from UI  ║
║  → Deleted property's historical data remains accessible          ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE P4: OCCUPANCY STATUS LOGIC                                     ║
║  → OCCUPIED: has lease where status='active' and end > today      ║
║  → VACANT:   no active lease OR all leases expired                ║
║  → RESERVED: has lease where status='pending' and start > today   ║
║  → Status is COMPUTED — not manually set by landlord              ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE P5: PROPERTY SEARCH & FILTER                                   ║
║  → Search: searches name, address, unit number (ORM icontains)    ║
║  → Filter by: occupancy status, property type, rent range         ║
║  → Sort by: name, rent (asc/desc), date added, occupancy          ║
║  → Sort field MUST be from allowlist before order_by()            ║
║  → Pagination: 12 cards per page (grid), 25 rows per page (list)  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LOGIC:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC P1: When a property is added                                  ║
║  → Status is automatically set to 'vacant'                         ║
║  → A notification is created: "New property added: [name]"        ║
║  → Dashboard occupied/total count updates                          ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC P2: When a property transitions to occupied                   ║
║  → Triggered by: lease activation (lease start date reached)      ║
║  → Property status computed field updates automatically            ║
║  → Dashboard metrics recalculate                                   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC P3: When rent is changed on an occupied property              ║
║  → System shows warning: "Rent change applies to next lease only" ║
║  → Current active lease rent is NOT changed                        ║
║  → New rent is stored on property record for next lease creation  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR PROPERTIES:                                   ║
║  ✅ Property queryset always filtered by landlord=request.user     ║
║  ✅ Delete blocked server-side if active lease exists              ║
║  ✅ Rent validated as Decimal with min/max server-side             ║
║  ✅ Property name/address auto-escaped in all templates            ║
║  ✅ Sort parameter allowlisted before order_by()                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# 📋 PART 4: PAGE 3 — LEASES
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: LEASES (/landlord/leases/)                                    ║
║  PURPOSE: Contract hub — agreements and tenant onboarding            ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW L1: A LEASE IS A LEGALLY BINDING CONTRACT                       ║
║  → Source: Law of Contract Act Cap 23                               ║
║  → Parties: landlord (offer) + tenant (acceptance)                 ║
║  → Consideration: rent payment in exchange for occupation           ║
║  → Once active, lease terms cannot be changed unilaterally         ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW L2: LEASE MUST HAVE A DEFINED TERM                              ║
║  → Source: Landlord and Tenant Act Cap 301                         ║
║  → Minimum lease duration: 30 days                                 ║
║  → Maximum lease duration: 3 years (1095 days) without renewal    ║
║  → Start date must be a future or current date                    ║
║  → End date must be after start date                              ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW L3: ONE TENANT PER UNIT AT A TIME                               ║
║  → Source: Property law — exclusive possession right               ║
║  → No two active leases can overlap for the same unit             ║
║  → Even a 1-day overlap is illegal and must be rejected           ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW L4: NOTICE PERIOD FOR TERMINATION                               ║
║  → Source: Landlord and Tenant Act Cap 301                         ║
║  → Monthly tenancy: minimum 1 month written notice                 ║
║  → Fixed term: notice terms as stated in lease agreement           ║
║  → System records termination date and reason for evidence        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW L5: SECURITY DEPOSIT RULES                                      ║
║  → Source: Rent Restriction Act Cap 296                            ║
║  → Maximum security deposit: 2 months rent                        ║
║  → Deposit must be returned within 30 days of lease end            ║
║  → Deductions from deposit must be itemized and documented        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE L1: LEASE STATUS LIFECYCLE                                     ║
║                                                                       ║
║  PENDING → ACTIVE → EXPIRED                                         ║
║                ↓                                                     ║
║           TERMINATED                                                 ║
║                                                                       ║
║  → PENDING:    created, start date in future, not yet begun        ║
║  → ACTIVE:     start date reached, end date not yet passed         ║
║  → EXPIRED:    end date has passed, no renewal created             ║
║  → TERMINATED: manually ended before natural expiry                ║
║  → Status transitions are SYSTEM-DRIVEN (via Celery tasks)        ║
║  → Landlord CANNOT manually set status to 'active' or 'expired'  ║
║  → Landlord CAN manually terminate with reason                    ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE L2: LEASE CREATION VALIDATION                                  ║
║  → Unit must exist and be owned by request.user                   ║
║  → Unit must be VACANT for the requested date range               ║
║  → Tenant (invited email) must not already have active lease      ║
║    on another unit (one active lease per tenant per landlord)     ║
║  → Rent amount: KES 1,000 min, KES 5,000,000 max                 ║
║  → Rent must be >= property base rent (cannot undercut own price) ║
║  → Security deposit: 0 to 2 months rent maximum                   ║
║  → Overlap check: STRICT — even 1 day overlap is rejected        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE L3: LEASE INVITATION FLOW                                      ║
║  → Landlord creates lease and provides tenant email               ║
║  → System sends invitation email with secure link (24hr expiry)  ║
║  → If tenant has no account: link creates account then signs      ║
║  → If tenant has account: link presents lease for acceptance      ║
║  → Lease status stays 'pending' until tenant accepts              ║
║  → Landlord can resend invite (max 3 times, then must restart)   ║
║  → Invite link is single-use — expires on use or 24 hours        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE L4: LEASE RENEWAL RULES                                        ║
║  → Renewal creates a NEW lease record (does not extend old one)   ║
║  → New lease must start the day AFTER old lease ends              ║
║  → Or new lease can start up to 60 days after old lease ends      ║
║  → Gap > 60 days: unit is marked vacant, new lease treated fresh ║
║  → Rent on renewal can be different from original                 ║
║  → Security deposit on renewal: carried forward or re-specified   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE L5: LEASE TERMINATION RULES                                    ║
║  → Only landlord who owns the lease can terminate it              ║
║  → Termination requires a reason (50-500 characters)              ║
║  → Termination is IMMEDIATE in system (status → terminated)      ║
║  → Termination does NOT automatically cancel unpaid invoices      ║
║  → Unpaid invoices before termination remain due                  ║
║  → Termination triggers notification to tenant                    ║
║  → Termination event is permanently recorded in audit log         ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE L6: LEASE CANNOT BE DELETED                                    ║
║  → Leases are LEGAL CONTRACTS — never delete                      ║
║  → Soft delete only — visible in archived view                    ║
║  → Must retain for 7 years minimum                                ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE L7: EXPIRY WARNING AUTOMATION                                  ║
║  → System automatically sends warning at 60 days before expiry   ║
║  → System sends second warning at 14 days before expiry           ║
║  → System sends final warning at 7 days before expiry             ║
║  → All warnings are logged as system notifications               ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LOGIC:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC L1: Daily Celery task — lease status transitions             ║
║  → Run at 00:01 every day                                          ║
║  → Find all PENDING leases where start_date = today              ║
║    → Change status to ACTIVE                                       ║
║  → Find all ACTIVE leases where end_date < today                 ║
║    → Change status to EXPIRED                                      ║
║  → Find all ACTIVE leases expiring in 60, 14, 7 days             ║
║    → Create expiry warning notifications                          ║
║  → Log all transitions to audit log                               ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC L2: When lease becomes ACTIVE                                 ║
║  → Property status computed field → OCCUPIED                      ║
║  → First invoice auto-generated for first month                   ║
║  → Welcome notification sent to tenant                            ║
║  → Dashboard metrics update                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC L3: When lease becomes EXPIRED or TERMINATED                  ║
║  → Property status computed field → VACANT                        ║
║  → Open maintenance tickets remain — still need resolution        ║
║  → Unpaid invoices remain due — debt does not disappear           ║
║  → Tenant directory status → 'moved out'                          ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR LEASES:                                       ║
║  ✅ Overlap check uses pure ORM parameterized date comparison      ║
║  ✅ Lease queryset always filtered by property__landlord=user      ║
║  ✅ Status transitions only via Celery tasks, not direct API write ║
║  ✅ Termination verifies property.landlord == request.user         ║
║  ✅ Invitation token is single-use and time-limited                ║
║  ✅ Tenant names auto-escaped in all lease table displays          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# 💰 PART 5: PAGE 4 — FINANCIALS
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: FINANCIALS (/landlord/financials/)                            ║
║  PURPOSE: Invoice ledger, late fees, revenue reporting               ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW F1: RENT MUST BE INVOICED BEFORE COLLECTION                     ║
║  → Source: Law of Contract Act                                     ║
║  → Landlord must issue invoice before demanding payment            ║
║  → Invoice must state: amount, due date, what it is for           ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW F2: LATE FEE MUST BE PRE-DISCLOSED IN LEASE                    ║
║  → Source: Consumer Protection Act 2012                            ║
║  → Late fee rate must be in the signed lease agreement            ║
║  → Cannot apply late fee not mentioned in lease                   ║
║  → System rate: 5% of base rent after 5-day grace period         ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW F3: FINANCIAL RECORDS RETAINED 7 YEARS                          ║
║  → Source: Kenya Revenue Authority                                 ║
║  → All invoice, payment, and fee records kept 7 years minimum    ║
║  → Never hard delete any financial record                         ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW F4: RENTAL INCOME IS TAXABLE                                    ║
║  → Source: Kenya Income Tax Act                                    ║
║  → Landlord's rental income subject to 10% withholding tax        ║
║  → System shows gross income — landlord responsible for filing    ║
║  → System provides exportable records to support tax filing       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE F1: INVOICE GENERATION RULES                                   ║
║  → Invoice generated automatically when lease becomes ACTIVE      ║
║  → Invoice generated on 1st of every month for active leases     ║
║  → Invoice due date: 5th of the month (5-day grace period)       ║
║  → Invoice amount = lease.monthly_rent (base amount)             ║
║  → One invoice per lease per month — no duplicates               ║
║  → Invoice number: auto-incremented, unique, never reused         ║
║  → Invoice cannot be manually created for non-existent lease     ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE F2: INVOICE STATUS LIFECYCLE                                   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  PENDING → PAID                                                      ║
║     ↓                                                                ║
║  OVERDUE → PAID (with late fee)                                      ║
║     ↓                                                                ║
║  BAD DEBT (if tenant vacates without paying)                        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  → PENDING:  generated, due date not yet passed                   ║
║  → OVERDUE:  due date + grace period passed, still unpaid         ║
║  → PAID:     payment recorded (full amount including any fees)    ║
║  → BAD DEBT: lease terminated/expired, invoice still unpaid       ║
║  → Status CANNOT be manually set to PAID without payment record  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE F3: LATE FEE APPLICATION RULES                                 ║
║  → Applied automatically by Celery task daily at 00:01           ║
║  → Applies on: invoice.due_date + 5 grace period days           ║
║  → Rate: exactly 5% of base rent (not of total with previous fee) ║
║  → Late fee applied ONCE per invoice — not compounding daily     ║
║  → Late fee is a SEPARATE line item on the invoice               ║
║  → Total due = base rent + late fee                              ║
║  → Late fee is only applied if lease was active when fee applied ║
║  → Late fee cannot be applied to already-PAID invoices           ║
║  → Late fee can only be waived by landlord with reason (audit)   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE F4: PAYMENT RECORDING RULES                                    ║
║  → Payment must be linked to a specific invoice                   ║
║  → Payment amount must be >= total invoice amount (base + fee)   ║
║  → Partial payment is allowed but invoice remains PENDING         ║
║  → Partial payment records the amount received with timestamp     ║
║  → Overpayment: excess recorded as credit for next invoice       ║
║  → Payment method: M-Pesa, bank transfer, cash (offline)         ║
║  → Cash payment requires landlord manual confirmation             ║
║  → All payments are timestamped at server time (UTC stored)      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE F5: INVOICE FILTER RULES                                       ║
║  → Filter by: property, month, year, status, payment method      ║
║  → All filters scoped to landlord's properties only              ║
║  → Date range maximum: 24 months at a time (prevent exhaustion)  ║
║  → Default view: current month                                    ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE F6: EXPORT RULES                                               ║
║  → CSV export: all visible filtered records                       ║
║  → PDF export: formatted invoice summary report                   ║
║  → Export is logged in audit log (who, when, date range)         ║
║  → Export includes: invoice #, tenant, unit, amount, status, date║
║  → Export does NOT include tenant ID numbers or passwords         ║
║  → Export cells starting with =, +, -, @ are prefixed with '    ║
║    (prevents CSV formula injection in Excel/Sheets)              ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LOGIC:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC F1: Monthly invoice Celery task                               ║
║  → Runs 00:01 on 1st of each month                                ║
║  → Finds all ACTIVE leases                                         ║
║  → Generates invoice for each: amount=lease.monthly_rent          ║
║  → Due date: 5th of current month                                 ║
║  → Sends invoice notification to tenant                           ║
║  → Sends invoice summary notification to landlord                 ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC F2: Late fee Celery task                                      ║
║  → Runs daily at 00:01                                             ║
║  → Finds invoices: status=PENDING, due_date + 5 days < today     ║
║  → Applies 5% late fee if not already applied                    ║
║  → Changes status to OVERDUE                                      ║
║  → Logs: which invoice, which landlord, fee amount, timestamp    ║
║  → Sends overdue notification to landlord and tenant             ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR FINANCIALS:                                   ║
║  ✅ Invoice queryset always scoped to landlord's properties        ║
║  ✅ Payment amounts validated as Decimal server-side               ║
║  ✅ CSV export cells sanitized for formula injection               ║
║  ✅ Late fee calculated server-side only — never trusted from client║
║  ✅ Invoice status transitions via Celery, not direct API writes   ║
║  ✅ Financial amounts auto-escaped before JS chart injection       ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# 💬 PART 6: PAGE 5 — CHAT
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: CHAT (/landlord/chat/)                                        ║
║  PURPOSE: Real-time messaging with assigned tenants                  ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW C1: LANDLORD CAN ONLY MESSAGE THEIR OWN TENANTS                ║
║  → Source: Privacy + Data Protection Act 2019                      ║
║  → Cannot initiate or receive messages from non-tenants            ║
║  → Cannot access conversations of other landlords                  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW C2: CHAT MESSAGES ARE LEGAL COMMUNICATION RECORDS              ║
║  → Source: Law of Contract Act — written communication             ║
║  → Messages may be used as evidence in tenancy disputes            ║
║  → Messages cannot be deleted by landlord after sending            ║
║  → Messages must be stored with accurate timestamps                ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW C3: NO HARASSMENT VIA PLATFORM                                  ║
║  → Source: Consumer Protection Act + Employment Act                ║
║  → System may flag or block accounts for abusive messaging        ║
║  → Platform is not liable for message content (safe harbor)       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE C1: CONVERSATION SCOPE                                         ║
║  → Landlord can only see conversations with their tenants         ║
║  → A tenant is "theirs" if there is an ACTIVE or RECENT lease    ║
║    (lease ended within last 90 days — for move-out communication) ║
║  → No conversation accessible if tenant has no lease relationship ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE C2: MESSAGE CONTENT RULES                                      ║
║  → Maximum message length: 2,000 characters                       ║
║  → Plain text only — no HTML, no Markdown rendering               ║
║  → URLs in messages are displayed as plain text (not clickable)  ║
║    unless validated as safe (https:// only, known domains)       ║
║  → Message must not be empty or whitespace-only                   ║
║  → Message stored after server-side sanitization                  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE C3: FILE ATTACHMENT RULES                                      ║
║  → Allowed types: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG (same as Documents page)   ║
║  → Maximum file size: 5MB per attachment                          ║
║  → One attachment per message                                     ║
║  → Attachment served via authenticated download URL only          ║
║  → File name sanitized before storage and display                 ║
║  → MIME type verified server-side before storage                  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE C4: READ RECEIPTS                                              ║
║  → Message marked 'read' when recipient opens the conversation    ║
║  → Read status visible to sender                                  ║
║  → Read timestamp stored (UTC)                                    ║
║  → Unread count shown in sidebar badge                           ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE C5: MESSAGE DELETION POLICY                                    ║
║  → Landlord CANNOT delete sent messages                           ║
║  → Tenant CANNOT delete received messages                         ║
║  → Admin can delete for legal compliance only (with audit log)   ║
║  → This protects both parties in legal disputes                   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE C6: ONLINE STATUS RULES                                        ║
║  → Online = WebSocket connection active                           ║
║  → Last seen timestamp updated on connection close                ║
║  → Last seen is visible to landlord for their tenants only       ║
║  → Online status cannot be faked by client                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LOGIC:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC C1: Message flow                                              ║
║  → Landlord types message → client sends via WebSocket           ║
║  → Server receives → validates sender is landlord                 ║
║  → Server validates receiver is landlord's tenant                 ║
║  → Server sanitizes message content                               ║
║  → Server saves to DB with timestamp                              ║
║  → Server broadcasts to tenant's WebSocket channel               ║
║  → Server creates notification for tenant                         ║
║  → Server creates notification for landlord (sent confirmation)  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC C2: Attachment flow                                           ║
║  → Landlord drops file → client validates type/size              ║
║  → Client sends via HTTP POST (not WebSocket) — multipart        ║
║  → Server validates MIME type, size, extension                    ║
║  → Server generates secure file path with UUID filename           ║
║  → Server saves attachment record linked to message              ║
║  → Server returns signed download URL (time-limited)              ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR CHAT:                                         ║
║  ✅ WebSocket auth verified on EVERY message, not just connect     ║
║  ✅ Receiver is validated as landlord's tenant server-side         ║
║  ✅ ALL messages rendered with textContent — NEVER innerHTML       ║
║  ✅ Message content sanitized before DB save AND before broadcast  ║
║  ✅ File attachment MIME verified with magic bytes server-side    ║
║  ✅ Message queryset scoped to landlord's tenant conversations     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# 🔧 PART 7: PAGE 6 — MAINTENANCE
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: MAINTENANCE (/landlord/maintenance/)                          ║
║  PURPOSE: Kanban workflow for repair requests                        ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW M1: LANDLORD'S DUTY TO REPAIR                                   ║
║  → Source: Landlord and Tenant Act Cap 301                         ║
║  → Landlord legally obligated to maintain habitable conditions    ║
║  → Structural repairs: landlord's responsibility                   ║
║  → Emergency repairs: must be addressed within 24 hours           ║
║  → Non-emergency: reasonable time (industry standard: 14 days)   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW M2: REPAIR RECORDS AS LEGAL EVIDENCE                            ║
║  → Maintenance records can be used in court disputes              ║
║  → Records must show: reported date, action taken, resolved date  ║
║  → System provides this audit trail automatically                  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE M1: TICKET PRIORITY DEFINITIONS                                ║
║  → EMERGENCY: life safety risk (gas leak, flood, electrical fire) ║
║    Required response: 24 hours                                    ║
║    Visual: red border, top of queue, immediate notification       ║
║  → HIGH: major habitability issue (no water, no power, broken AC) ║
║    Required response: 3 business days                             ║
║  → MEDIUM: significant inconvenience (leaking tap, broken lock)  ║
║    Required response: 7 business days                             ║
║  → LOW: cosmetic issues (paint, minor fixtures)                   ║
║    Required response: 14 business days                            ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE M2: TICKET STATUS TRANSITIONS                                  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  PENDING → IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED                                   ║
║     ↑                                                                ║
║  (can move back from IN_PROGRESS to PENDING if work paused)        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  → PENDING:     submitted, landlord not yet started               ║
║  → IN_PROGRESS: landlord has started work / arranged contractor   ║
║  → RESOLVED:    work completed and confirmed                       ║
║  → Cannot skip from PENDING directly to RESOLVED                  ║
║  → RESOLVED tickets cannot be moved back                          ║
║  → Status change is logged with timestamp in audit                ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE M3: TICKET CREATION RULES                                      ║
║  → Only tenants can CREATE tickets (from their side)             ║
║  → Landlord can create on behalf of tenant (for reporting)        ║
║  → Title: 5-100 characters, required                             ║
║  → Description: 10-1000 characters, required                     ║
║  → Priority: must be from allowlist [emergency, high, medium, low]║
║  → Unit: must be a unit the landlord owns                        ║
║  → Photos: optional, max 3 photos, each max 5MB, JPG/PNG only    ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE M4: TICKET VISIBILITY                                          ║
║  → Landlord sees all tickets for all their properties             ║
║  → Cannot see tickets for other landlords' properties             ║
║  → Resolved tickets stay visible for 90 days then archived        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE M5: KANBAN DRAG RULES                                          ║
║  → Status change via drag must be validated server-side           ║
║  → Client sends PATCH request — server validates the transition   ║
║  → Invalid transitions are rejected with 400 error               ║
║  → Status value from client must be from allowlist               ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LOGIC:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC M1: Emergency ticket notification                             ║
║  → When emergency ticket created: immediate in-app notification  ║
║  → Email notification sent to landlord immediately                ║
║  → SLA timer starts: 24 hours to acknowledge                     ║
║  → If not moved to IN_PROGRESS within 24h: escalation alert      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC M2: Resolution logging                                        ║
║  → When ticket moved to RESOLVED                                   ║
║  → Resolution timestamp recorded                                   ║
║  → Resolution time calculated: created_at to resolved_at          ║
║  → Resolution time shown in analytics for performance tracking   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR MAINTENANCE:                                  ║
║  ✅ Ticket queryset filtered by unit__property__landlord=user      ║
║  ✅ Status value from PATCH request allowlisted before save        ║
║  ✅ Ticket description auto-escaped in Kanban card template        ║
║  ✅ Photo MIME type verified server-side on upload                 ║
║  ✅ Photo file names sanitized (no path traversal)                ║
║  ✅ Invalid status transitions rejected server-side                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# 👥 PART 8: PAGE 7 — TENANTS
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: TENANTS (/landlord/tenants/)                                  ║
║  PURPOSE: CRM directory of tenant relationships                      ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW T1: LANDLORD MAY ONLY VIEW TENANTS THEY HAVE RELATIONSHIP WITH ║
║  → Source: Data Protection Act 2019                                ║
║  → Landlord can view tenants with CURRENT or PAST (≤2 years) lease║
║  → Cannot view tenants belonging to other landlords               ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW T2: TENANT DATA ACCURACY OBLIGATION                             ║
║  → Landlord must ensure tenant data is accurate for legal docs    ║
║  → Incorrect emergency contacts can cause legal liability         ║
║  → System shows when tenant data was last updated                 ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW T3: ANTI-DISCRIMINATION LAW                                     ║
║  → Source: Constitution of Kenya 2010 Article 27                  ║
║  → System must not allow discrimination filters                   ║
║  → Filter options: ONLY by lease status, payment status, unit    ║
║  → NO filter by race, religion, gender, nationality               ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE T1: TENANT VISIBILITY RULES                                    ║
║  → ACTIVE:    lease status = 'active' — current tenant           ║
║  → MOVED OUT: lease status = 'expired' or 'terminated'           ║
║    Visible for 2 years after move-out for records/debt recovery  ║
║  → INVITED:   invitation sent, lease status = 'pending'          ║
║  → Cannot see tenants from leases older than 2 years             ║
║    (they are archived — accessible via export, not live UI)      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE T2: TENANT DATA LANDLORD CAN SEE                              ║
║  → Name, email, phone (from their profile)                        ║
║  → Unit, lease dates, monthly rent                                ║
║  → Payment history (their invoices only)                          ║
║  → Maintenance tickets (their unit only)                          ║
║  → Emergency contact name and phone                               ║
║  → Last active / move-in / move-out dates                        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE T3: TENANT DATA LANDLORD CANNOT SEE                           ║
║  → Tenant's password (never stored in plaintext)                  ║
║  → Tenant's bank account details                                   ║
║  → Tenant's data on OTHER landlords' properties                   ║
║  → Tenant's private documents (only shared ones)                  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE T4: SEARCH AND FILTER RULES                                    ║
║  → Search: by name, email, unit number (ORM icontains)           ║
║  → Filter: active/moved-out/invited status only                   ║
║  → Sort: by name, move-in date, payment status                   ║
║  → All searches scoped to landlord's tenants only                ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE T5: MESSAGE ROUTING FROM TENANT PAGE                          ║
║  → "Message Tenant" button routes to Chat page                    ║
║  → Opens the specific conversation with that tenant               ║
║  → Does not open a new channel — uses existing conversation       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LOGIC:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC T1: Tenant status determination                               ║
║  → Computed from lease status — not stored on tenant record       ║
║  → Same tenant can be ACTIVE for one landlord, MOVED OUT for another║
║  → Status label: "Active at Unit 4A" not just "Active"            ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LOGIC T2: Emergency contact display                                 ║
║  → Emergency contact data provided by tenant during onboarding   ║
║  → Landlord can VIEW but not EDIT emergency contacts              ║
║  → Only tenant can update their own emergency contacts            ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR TENANTS:                                      ║
║  ✅ Tenant queryset scoped via lease__property__landlord=user      ║
║  ✅ All tenant fields auto-escaped in list and drawer templates    ║
║  ✅ Search uses ORM icontains — no raw string query                ║
║  ✅ Landlord cannot edit tenant's personal profile data            ║
║  ✅ Sensitive data (ID numbers) not shown on this page             ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# 📁 PART 9: PAGE 8 — DOCUMENTS
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: DOCUMENTS (/landlord/documents/)                              ║
║  PURPOSE: Secure vault for legal and property files                  ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW DO1: LEASE AGREEMENTS MUST BE DOCUMENTED                        ║
║  → Source: Law of Contract Act — written contracts recommended     ║
║  → Signed lease PDFs must be stored and accessible                 ║
║  → Documents are legal evidence in disputes                        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW DO2: DOCUMENT RETENTION PERIOD                                  ║
║  → Lease agreements: 7 years minimum after lease end               ║
║  → Financial documents: 7 years                                    ║
║  → Identity documents: only as long as relationship active        ║
║    Delete within 30 days of tenant move-out (Data Protection)    ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW DO3: SECURE DOCUMENT ACCESS                                     ║
║  → Only authenticated parties can access documents                 ║
║  → IDOR protection: landlord can only download their own docs     ║
║  → Unauthenticated URLs must not work                             ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE DO1: UPLOAD RULES                                              ║
║  → Allowed types: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, DOCX                       ║
║  → Maximum file size: 10MB per file                               ║
║  → Maximum files per folder: 500                                   ║
║  → Total storage per landlord: defined by subscription tier       ║
║  → File name: sanitized, max 100 characters                       ║
║  → Stored with UUID filename to prevent enumeration               ║
║  → Original filename stored in DB for display only                ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE DO2: FOLDER ORGANIZATION RULES                                 ║
║  → Default folders auto-created per property when property added  ║
║  → Landlord can create custom folders                             ║
║  → Folder name: 2-50 characters                                   ║
║  → Folders cannot be nested more than 1 level deep               ║
║  → Folders scoped to landlord — not shared                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE DO3: DOWNLOAD RULES                                            ║
║  → Download URL must include authentication token                  ║
║  → Signed URL expires in 1 hour                                   ║
║  → Every download is logged: who, what, when, IP                  ║
║  → Downloaded file served with Content-Disposition: attachment    ║
║  → Content-Type set to actual file type (not application/octet)  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE DO4: DELETE RULES                                              ║
║  → User must type "DELETE" in confirmation input                   ║
║  → Confirmation verified server-side (not just client-side)       ║
║  → Soft delete: file record marked deleted, kept 30 days          ║
║  → Hard delete: after 30 days or on landlord explicit purge       ║
║  → CANNOT delete: a document linked to an active lease            ║
║  → CANNOT delete: financial documents (7-year retention)          ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE DO5: SHARING RULES                                             ║
║  → Landlord can share documents with their tenants                ║
║  → Shared document creates tenant access record                   ║
║  → Tenant sees shared document in their portal                    ║
║  → Landlord can revoke access at any time                         ║
║  → Sharing with non-tenant email: not allowed                     ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR DOCUMENTS:                                    ║
║  ✅ Download URL is authenticated — no public file serving         ║
║  ✅ File stored outside web root or in private bucket             ║
║  ✅ MIME type verified with python-magic on upload                 ║
║  ✅ File names sanitized with os.path.basename()                  ║
║  ✅ Document queryset scoped to landlord=request.user             ║
║  ✅ Delete confirmation "DELETE" verified server-side             ║
║  ✅ Download logged in audit log                                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# 📊 PART 10: PAGE 9 — ANALYTICS
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: ANALYTICS (/landlord/analytics/)                              ║
║  PURPOSE: Visual intelligence from database records                  ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW AN1: ANALYTICS DATA IS LANDLORD-CONFIDENTIAL                    ║
║  → Financial performance data is proprietary business information  ║
║  → Must never be accessible to other landlords or tenants         ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE AN1: DATA SCOPE                                                ║
║  → ALL charts and metrics scoped to landlord's properties only    ║
║  → Date range maximum: 24 months for performance                  ║
║  → Default view: last 12 months                                   ║
║  → Available periods: 3, 6, 12, 24 months                        ║
║  → Period must be from allowlist — not free date input            ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE AN2: REVENUE TREND CHART RULES                                 ║
║  → Data source: SUM of PAID invoice amounts per month             ║
║  → Includes: base rent + late fees collected                      ║
║  → Excludes: pending, overdue invoices (not yet realized)         ║
║  → Each data point: month label + total collected KES amount      ║
║  → Missing months (no payments): shown as zero, not omitted       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE AN3: MAINTENANCE CATEGORY CHART RULES                          ║
║  → Data source: COUNT of tickets grouped by category              ║
║  → Scope: all tickets in selected period for landlord's units     ║
║  → All statuses included: pending, in_progress, resolved          ║
║  → Categories: plumbing, electrical, HVAC, structural, other      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE AN4: PAYMENT TIMELINESS CHART RULES                           ║
║  → ON TIME:    payment received on or before due_date             ║
║  → LATE:       payment received within 30 days after due_date     ║
║  → VERY LATE:  payment received more than 30 days after due_date  ║
║  → Only PAID invoices are classified (pending/overdue excluded)   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE AN5: CSV EXPORT RULES                                          ║
║  → Export: raw data behind the current chart                      ║
║  → All exported cells sanitized for CSV formula injection         ║
║  → Export logged: who, what chart, what period, when              ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE AN6: PROPERTY PERFORMANCE TABLE RULES                          ║
║  → Shows: revenue, collection rate, tickets, occupancy per unit  ║
║  → Net income = revenue - expenses for same period               ║
║  → ROI = (net income / total rent billed) × 100                  ║
║  → Only shown for properties with at least 1 lease in period     ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR ANALYTICS:                                    ║
║  ✅ All aggregate queries filtered by landlord's properties        ║
║  ✅ Period parameter allowlisted [3,6,12,24] before query          ║
║  ✅ Chart data passed via json_script tag — not raw template var  ║
║  ✅ CSV export cells prefixed to prevent formula injection         ║
║  ✅ No raw SQL in any aggregate or annotation                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# ⚙️ PART 12: PAGE 11 — SETTINGS
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: SETTINGS (/landlord/settings/)                                ║
║  PURPOSE: Account, security, bank, notification preferences          ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW S1: IDENTITY DATA ACCURACY                                      ║
║  → Landlord must provide accurate name and contact for contracts   ║
║  → False identity used in lease is fraud (Penal Code)             ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW S2: BANK DETAILS SECURITY                                       ║
║  → Bank details must be encrypted at rest                         ║
║  → Bank details never exposed in API response in full              ║
║  → Only last 4 digits of account shown in UI                     ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE S1: PROFILE UPDATE RULES                                       ║
║  → Name: 2-100 characters, letters + spaces + hyphens only        ║
║  → Email: cannot be changed without re-verification                ║
║  → Phone: Kenya format validated                                   ║
║  → Company name: optional, 2-100 characters                       ║
║  → Profile photo: JPG/PNG only, max 2MB, displayed as avatar      ║
║  → One profile per user account — no multiple profiles            ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE S2: PASSWORD CHANGE RULES                                      ║
║  → Must provide current password before changing                  ║
║  → New password: min 12 characters                                ║
║  → Must contain: uppercase, lowercase, number, special character  ║
║  → Cannot reuse last 5 passwords                                  ║
║  → Cannot be similar to email, name, or common words             ║
║  → Password change logs out all OTHER active sessions             ║
║  → Password change is audited: user, IP, timestamp               ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE S3: BANK DETAILS RULES                                         ║
║  → Bank name: from allowlist of Kenya licensed banks              ║
║  → Account name: 2-100 characters                                 ║
║  → Account number: 5-20 digits only                               ║
║  → M-Pesa number: Kenya format validated                          ║
║  → Stored encrypted (AES-256 at rest)                            ║
║  → Displayed: "Equity Bank ****7890"                             ║
║  → Cannot be changed more than 3 times per 30 days               ║
║    (prevents fraudulent bank account substitution)               ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE S4: NOTIFICATION PREFERENCE RULES                              ║
║  → Each notification type has independent on/off toggle           ║
║  → Toggle change saved immediately via API (not page reload)      ║
║  → Default: ALL notifications ON for new accounts                ║
║  → Cannot turn off: security alerts (login from new device)       ║
║  → Cannot turn off: lease termination notifications               ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE S5: EMAIL CHANGE RULES                                         ║
║  → New email must be unique in system                             ║
║  → Verification email sent to NEW email address                   ║
║  → Old email notified of the change attempt                       ║
║  → Change only effective when new email is verified               ║
║  → Change is audited: old email, new email, IP, timestamp        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR SETTINGS:                                     ║
║  ✅ Settings update only allows request.user's own account         ║
║  ✅ Bank details encrypted with EncryptedField before storage      ║
║  ✅ Current password verified before password change               ║
║  ✅ Password not returned in any API response                      ║
║  ✅ Bank account number masked in API response and template        ║
║  ✅ Bank change rate limit: max 3 times per 30 days               ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# 💸 PART 13: PAGE 12 — EXPENSES
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: EXPENSES (/landlord/expenses/)                                ║
║  PURPOSE: Expense log and net ROI ledger                             ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW E1: EXPENSE DOCUMENTATION FOR TAX DEDUCTION                     ║
║  → Source: Kenya Income Tax Act                                    ║
║  → Deductible expenses must be documented with receipts            ║
║  → System stores expense records that support tax claims           ║
║  → Expense records retained 7 years                               ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW E2: EXPENSE MUST BE PROPERTY-RELATED                            ║
║  → Only expenses related to the property business are deductible  ║
║  → System categories enforce property-related expense types        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE E1: EXPENSE CATEGORIES (ALLOWLIST)                             ║
║  → repairs_maintenance, taxes_levies, insurance                   ║
║  → cleaning_landscaping, utilities, management_fees               ║
║  → legal_professional, advertising, security, other               ║
║  → Category must be from this list — no free-text category        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE E2: EXPENSE CREATION RULES                                     ║
║  → Amount: KES 1 minimum, KES 5,000,000 maximum                   ║
║  → Date: cannot be future date (record actual expenses only)      ║
║  → Date: cannot be more than 7 years in past                     ║
║  → Property: must be owned by request.user                        ║
║  → Notes: optional, max 500 characters                            ║
║  → Payment type: 'digital' or 'cash' — required                  ║
║  → Receipt upload: optional, same rules as Documents page         ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE E3: NET INCOME CALCULATION RULES                               ║
║  → Net Income = Revenue Collected - Total Expenses (same period)  ║
║  → Revenue: SUM of PAID invoices for period                       ║
║  → Expenses: SUM of all logged expenses for period               ║
║  → Calculated server-side — never trusted from client             ║
║  → Per-property net: filtered by specific property                ║
║  → ROI % = (Net Income / Revenue) × 100                          ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE E4: EXPENSE EDIT AND DELETE RULES                              ║
║  → Can edit: notes, category (within 30 days of creation)        ║
║  → Cannot edit: amount or date after 30 days                     ║
║  → Soft delete only — retained for tax purposes                   ║
║  → Deleted expenses still count in historical reports             ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE E5: OFFLINE (CASH) PAYMENT RECORDING RULES                    ║
║  → Cash payments recorded manually by landlord                    ║
║  → Marked as 'cash' payment type                                  ║
║  → Cash payments have no automatic verification                   ║
║  → All cash records are audited with landlord as recorder         ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR EXPENSES:                                     ║
║  ✅ Expense queryset scoped to landlord=request.user               ║
║  ✅ Property FK verified as owned by request.user before save      ║
║  ✅ Amount validated as Decimal with min/max server-side           ║
║  ✅ Category validated against allowlist (ChoiceField)             ║
║  ✅ Net income calculated server-side — never from client data     ║
║  ✅ Notes auto-escaped in template display                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗

║                                                                       ║

║  → Building address: 5-255 characters, required                   ║

║  → Maximum 100 units per building                                  ║
║                                                                       ║

║  → Only landlord's own properties can be assigned to their building║
║  → One property/unit belongs to exactly ONE building               ║
║  → Cannot assign same unit to two buildings                       ║
║  → Unassigned units: visible in Properties page, not in Buildings ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE B3: BUILDING AGGREGATE RULES                                   ║

║  → Aggregate occupancy: occupied units / total units in building  ║
║  → Aggregate tickets: all open tickets for all units in building  ║
║  → All aggregates computed server-side                            ║

║  RULE B4: BUILDING DELETE RULES                                      ║
║  → Cannot delete building with active leases on any unit          ║
║  → Deleting building does NOT delete the units/properties inside  ║
║  → Units become unassigned when building is deleted               ║
║  → Soft delete only                                               ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR BUILDINGS:                                    ║
║  ✅ Building queryset scoped to landlord=request.user              ║
║  ✅ Unit assignment validates unit.landlord == request.user        ║
║  ✅ Building aggregate queries filtered through building→landlord  ║
║  ✅ Building name auto-escaped in accordion template               ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

# ⏰ PART 15: PAGE 14 — REMINDER (AUTOMATIONS)
## Business Logic, Rules & Laws

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAGE: REMINDER (/landlord/automations/)                             ║
║  PURPOSE: Control panel for scheduled reminders and automations      ║
╠══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS LAWS:                                                       ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW R1: AUTOMATED COMMUNICATIONS MUST BE ACCURATE                   ║
║  → Source: Consumer Protection Act 2012                            ║
║  → Automated emails must contain accurate information              ║
║  → Late fee emails must state exact amount and due date           ║
║  → Expiry warnings must state correct lease end date              ║
║                                                                       ║
║  LAW R2: TENANT CONSENT FOR AUTOMATED MESSAGES                       ║
║  → Source: Data Protection Act 2019                                ║
║  → Tenants consent to automated reminders at lease signing        ║
║  → Consent is recorded in lease acceptance                        ║
║  → Tenants can unsubscribe from non-essential reminders           ║
║                                                                       ║
║  BUSINESS RULES:                                                      ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE R1: AUTOMATION TYPES (HARDCODED — NEVER FROM USER INPUT)       ║
║  → RENT_REMINDER_3DAY:  email 3 days before rent due             ║
║  → LATE_FEE_AUTO:       apply 5% late fee after grace period     ║
║  → LEASE_EXPIRY_60DAY:  email 60 days before lease expiry        ║
║  → LEASE_EXPIRY_14DAY:  email 14 days before lease expiry        ║
║  → MONTHLY_REPORT:      email financial summary on 1st of month   ║
║                                                                       ║
║  CRITICAL SECURITY RULE:                                             ║
║  → Automation type names are HARDCODED in backend                 ║
║  → Frontend sends ONLY: automation_type + enabled (boolean)       ║
║  → Backend ignores any other fields in the request               ║
║  → Celery task names are NEVER derived from user input            ║
║  → This prevents Remote Code Execution via task injection         ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE R2: TOGGLE RULES                                               ║
║  → Each automation has independent on/off toggle                  ║
║  → Toggle change saved via API immediately (no page reload)       ║
║  → Toggle state persisted in DB per landlord                     ║
║  → LATE_FEE_AUTO: cannot be disabled if active leases exist       ║
║    (legal obligation to consistently apply disclosed fee policy)  ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE R3: AUTOMATION EXECUTION RULES                                 ║
║  → All automations run via Celery Beat scheduled tasks            ║
║  → Run time: 00:01 server time (UTC) daily                       ║
║  → Failed run: retried 3 times, then logged as failed             ║
║  → Execution log: task name, run time, success/fail, count       ║
║  → Landlord can see last run time and status on this page        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE R4: RENT REMINDER CONTENT RULES                                ║
║  → Email must include: tenant name, unit, amount due, due date   ║
║  → Email must include: payment instructions                       ║
║  → Email must NOT include: landlord's full bank details          ║
║  → Email subject: "Rent Reminder: [amount] due on [date]"        ║
║                                                                       ║
║  RULE R5: SCOPE OF AUTOMATIONS                                       ║
║  → Automations apply to ALL of landlord's ACTIVE leases          ║
║  → Cannot target individual tenants selectively via automation   ║
║  → For individual messages: use Chat page                         ║
║                                                                       ║
║  AI SECURITY CHECK FOR REMINDERS:                                    ║
║  ✅ Celery task names are hardcoded — NEVER from request data      ║
║  ✅ Toggle value validated as strict boolean server-side           ║
║  ✅ Automation type validated against hardcoded allowlist          ║
║  ✅ Automation config scoped to request.user only                  ║
║  ✅ Email content built server-side from DB — not from user input  ║
║  ✅ Automation execution logs accessible to landlord only          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```
